en/cd_wei/196720ac.text: Okay. Customer service and the cast are still online. Get me that email and I'll roll.
en/cd_wei/196720ac.zh: 好。客服跟演員都還在線上，妳拿到回信我就開拍。
en/cd_wei/196720ac.heard: Okay, customer service and the cast are still online. Give me that email and I'll roll.

en/client_chen/e6310bf6.text: My worry is that Finance sees a number and reads it as a guarantee. If we're one order short, they'll tell me to make up that order.
en/client_chen/e6310bf6.zh: 我最怕財務看到有數字就當保證。到時候少一筆，也會叫我補一筆。
en/client_chen/e6310bf6.heard: My worry is that Finance sees a number and reads it as a guarantee. If we're one order short, they'll tell me to make up that order.

en/cd_wei/5835c20f.text: We hand the studio back at four. Find out what we're actually shooting today so I know which shot to start with.
en/cd_wei/5835c20f.zh: 棚四點要還。妳幫我問清楚，今天到底要拍什麼，我才知道先拍哪顆。
en/cd_wei/5835c20f.heard: We hand the studio back at four. Find out what we're actually shooting today so I know which shot to start with.

en/player_f/ef586289.text: We can keep the counter spot, Manager Hsu. I'll hold the proof, but we need something printable by four.
en/player_f/ef586289.zh: 許經理，櫃位留得住。我先把稿壓著，四點前得換一張能印的。
en/player_f/ef586289.heard: We can keep the counter spot, Manager Hsu. I'll hold the proof, but we need something printable by 4:00.

en/player_f/58c14123.text: I can help you walk him through it this afternoon, Chen. Hold off on sending this for signature at noon. Let me find out which orders we can actually match.
en/player_f/58c14123.zh: 陳經理，下午我可以一起跟您老闆說明。中午這份先別送簽，我去問哪些訂單真的對得上。
en/player_f/58c14123.heard: I can help you walk him through it this afternoon, Chen. Hold off on sending this for signature at noon. Let me find out which orders we can actually match.

en/client_chen/5be572bf.text: Now he wants the whole budget on traffic. This morning he sent me an article about cookies going away and asked if I'd sign off on that number.
en/client_chen/5be572bf.zh: 現在他要把預算全拿去買流量。早上又丟了 Cookie 要停用的新聞給我，問我這數字敢不敢簽。
en/client_chen/5be572bf.heard: Now he wants the whole budget on traffic. This morning he sent me an article about cookies going away and asked if I'd sign off on that number.

en/player_f/1039e2cd.text: I'll call her first. If she's worried about getting cornered tonight, I'll join the meeting and spell out what we can deliver and what costs extra.
en/player_f/1039e2cd.zh: 我先打給窗口。她要是怕今晚被問倒，我陪她進會議，把能交的跟要加錢的講清楚。
en/player_f/1039e2cd.heard: I'll call her first. If she's worried about getting cornered tonight, I'll join the meeting and spell out what we can deliver and what costs extra.

en/player_f/2d701d7e.text: Okay, let's strike the line about counting every in-store order. I'll bring the original contract so Chen can compare the two versions.
en/player_f/2d701d7e.zh: 好，先把門市訂單全算進去那句畫掉。我開會會帶合約原稿，讓陳經理能直接對照。
en/player_f/2d701d7e.heard: Okay, let's strike the line about counting every in-store order. I'll bring the original contract so Chan can compare the two versions.

en/player_f/d2381ab4.text: Got it. I'll put that in my notes. Chen just messaged me on LINE asking if he can put 'demand is down' in his deck.
en/player_f/d2381ab4.zh: 好，我只寫這一間。陳經理剛傳 LINE，問我能不能在簡報上寫『需求下滑』。
en/player_f/d2381ab4.heard: Got it. I'll put that in my notes. Chun just messaged me on LINE, asking if he can put Demand is down in his deck.

en/ae_mei/a0783451.text: The brand video is almost final, too. If we're keeping that budget, we need Chen to get someone to make the call in this meeting.
en/ae_mei/a0783451.zh: 品牌檔期的影片也快定稿了。要留這筆預算，等一下就得請陳經理找人拍板。
en/ae_mei/a0783451.heard: The brand video is almost final too. If we're keeping that budget, we need Chen to get someone to make the call in this meeting.

en/player_f/87255f11.text: Okay. I'll tell you what we can deliver for the sale and send the meeting notes with it.
en/player_f/87255f11.zh: 好，我先跟您說這檔能交什麼，會議紀錄我也一起寄。
en/player_f/87255f11.heard: Okay, I'll tell you what we can deliver for the sale and send the meeting notes with it.

en/ae_mei/9a0af392.text: I found the contract attachment. It covers one 30-second spot. If we're delivering a second cut, someone needs to sign a change order today.
en/ae_mei/9a0af392.zh: 合約附件我翻到了，只有一支三十秒。要多交一支，今天就得有人簽追加單。
en/ae_mei/9a0af392.heard: I found the contract attachment. It covers one 30-second spot. If we're delivering a second cut, someone needs to sign a change order today.

ae_mei/8c9ff94b.text: 客戶明早八點要發 LINE，老闆下午就要看訂單。妳要縮活動，我現在就得打給他。
ae_mei/8c9ff94b.heard: 客戶明早八點要發Line，老闆下午就要看訂單，你要縮活動，我現在就得打給他。

en/client_hsu/9c84147a.text: Here's the proof for the anniversary sale. HQ just emailed. We can't use the plastic reduction figure yet.
en/client_hsu/9c84147a.zh: 這張是週年慶的立牌打樣。總部剛回信，說減塑那行數字還不能用。
en/client_hsu/9c84147a.heard: Here's the proof for the anniversary sale. HQ just emailed. We can't use the plastic reduction figure yet.

en/player_f/796734a1.text: The franchise group chat's already announced an 8 AM launch. The client even asked if they could reuse the image for next month's store opening.
en/player_f/796734a1.zh: 加盟群都貼出明早八點開賣了。客戶還問我，下個月開新店能不能繼續用這張。
en/player_f/796734a1.heard: The franchise group chats already announced an 8:00 a.m. launch. The client even asked if they could reuse the image for next month's store opening

en/data_kai/8cccfce9.text: The quote just says 'new product promotion.' It doesn't say where we can use AI or whether franchisees can print the artwork.
en/data_kai/8cccfce9.zh: 報價單只寫新品宣傳，沒寫 AI 用在哪，也沒寫加盟店能不能拿去印。
en/data_kai/8cccfce9.heard: The quote just says, "new product promotion." It doesn't say whether we can use AI or whether franchisees can print the artwork.

en/ae_mei/6809307c.text: I checked the contract. It covers one sign. Extra staff or a new spot needs a signed addendum today.
en/ae_mei/6809307c.zh: 我翻過合約了，只含一張立牌。要加人或換版位，今天就得補簽。
en/ae_mei/6809307c.heard: I checked the contract, it covers one sign. Extra staff or a new spot needs a signed addendum today.

en/data_kai/68d9a9ee.text: Hold off on sending the print files. I got to the last page and couldn't trace the pattern on the cup sleeve in the AI image.
en/data_kai/68d9a9ee.zh: 先別寄交印檔。我核到最後一頁，AI 主圖裡那個杯套花紋，查不到來源。
en/data_kai/68d9a9ee.heard: Hold off on sending the print files. I got to the last page and couldn't trace the pattern on the cup sleeve in the AI image.

en/player_f/f3dd64f1.text: Our marketing contact told me the brand film was approved this morning. Now she's worried her boss will put her on the spot at tonight's meeting.
en/player_f/f3dd64f1.zh: 行銷窗口早上才說品牌片過了。她現在怕晚上開會，老闆拿這句問她。
en/player_f/f3dd64f1.heard: Our marketing contact told me the brand film was approved this morning. Now, she's worried her boss will put her on the spot at tonight's meeting.

en/client_chen/e4f320a5.text: Find Ah-Kai at Lanshan Plaza. He's got last year's order files. I'll send you a photo of page seven.
en/client_chen/e4f320a5.zh: 去藍山廣場找阿凱，去年的訂單檔在他那。我把第七頁拍給你。
en/client_chen/e4f320a5.heard: Find Akai at Lanshan Plaza. He's got last year's order files. I'll send you a photo of page seven.

en/ae_mei/095f7033.text: The client just messaged me. She's worried her boss will think she's holding things up. The printer needs files by five. Give her something she can take back to him.
en/ae_mei/095f7033.zh: 客戶剛敲我，怕老闆以為她在拖。印廠五點收檔，妳先給她一句能回老闆的話。
en/ae_mei/095f7033.heard: The client just messaged me. She's worried her boss will think she's holding things up. The printer needs files by 5:00. Give her something she can take back to him.

en/ae_mei/033e669d.text: You're the AE on this. Look at the deck the client just sent HQ. It says the neighborhood shops are joining next week.
en/ae_mei/033e669d.zh: 妳是這案的業務，先看一下。客戶剛把給總部的簡報傳來，上面寫商圈店家下週一起上。
en/ae_mei/033e669d.heard: You're the AE on this. Look at the deck the client just sent HQ. It says the neighborhood shops are joining next week.

en/player_f/3fde38a5.text: I'll call. Can you ask Wei how many placements he can cover tonight with the photos we shot?
en/player_f/3fde38a5.zh: 我來打。你幫我問威哥，現拍的產品照今晚能出幾個版位？
en/player_f/3fde38a5.heard: I'll call. Can you ask Wei how many placements he can cover tonight with the photos we shot?

en/player_f/9450ebd2.text: I'll take the ice shop out. If the fabric shop only has to lend us the window and won't have to handle a line, how soon can we get their approval?
en/player_f/9450ebd2.zh: 那冰店先拿掉。布莊如果只放櫥窗、不接排隊的人，確認稿最快什麼時候回得來？
en/player_f/9450ebd2.heard: I'll take the eyeshop out. If the fabric shop only has to lend us the window and won't have to handle a line, how soon can we get their approval?

en/data_kai/0c53200f.text: If the manager can put someone on cashier training today, we'll have the first week's numbers next Friday. I can't give you figures for every store.
en/data_kai/0c53200f.zh: 店長今天肯排人教收銀，下週五就有第一週的數字。全店的數字我給不了。
en/data_kai/0c53200f.heard: If the manager can put someone on cashier training today, we'll have the first week's numbers next Friday. I can't give you figures for every store.

en/data_kai/e26f9db5.text: On it. Ask the client this, too. If she can only have one thing by morning, does she want the in-store poster or the order page?
en/data_kai/e26f9db5.zh: 我去問。妳也問客戶一下，明早要是只能先交一樣，她要門市海報還是點餐頁？
en/data_kai/e26f9db5.heard: On it. Ask the client this, too. If she could only have one thing by morning, does she want the in-store poster or the order page?

en/ae_mei/38ba8698.text: Good. Call the client before the nine o'clock pitch so they know what's still up in the air before they present.
en/ae_mei/38ba8698.zh: 好。九點比稿前先打給客戶，讓他上台前知道哪些還沒談定。
en/ae_mei/38ba8698.heard: Good. Call the client before the 9:00 pitch, so they know what's still up in the air before they present.

player_m/b9df1c64.text: 等一下，我想先挑一件事試。兩個一起上，下週還是只能猜。
player_m/b9df1c64.heard: 等一下，我想先挑一件試試，兩個一起上下週還是只能拆。

en/player_f/46423be9.text: Got it. I'll write down who can sign and when they can get back to us, so I have something concrete for the call.
en/player_f/46423be9.zh: 懂了。我先把誰能簽、幾點能回寫清楚，等一下電話裡才有東西能談。
en/player_f/46423be9.heard: Got it. I'll write down who can sign and when they can get back to us, so I have something concrete for the call.

en/player_f/755f0528.text: Auntie, there are two kinds on the shelf. Which one did you grab?
en/player_f/755f0528.zh: 阿姨，架上有兩種瓶子耶。您拿的是哪一瓶？
en/player_f/755f0528.heard: Auntie, there are two kinds on the shelf. Which one did you grab?

en/vendor_cheng/f7b068c4.text: The ice shop owner saw the photos from the last opening. He doesn't want another line blocking his door. The fabric shop will lend us its window if the owner can approve the shop name and photos first.
en/vendor_cheng/f7b068c4.zh: 冰店老闆看到上次的排隊照片，說不想再堵門。布莊倒是願意借窗，只是店名跟照片得先給他看。
en/vendor_cheng/f7b068c4.heard: The eye shop owner saw the photos from the last opening. He doesn't want another line blocking his door. The fabric shop will lend us its window if the owner can approve the shop name and photos first.

en/vendor_cheng/2806347e.text: The fabric shop owner's in tonight. The tofu pudding stall won't get back to us till morning. They can't take vouchers when it's too busy, so agree on a daily cap up front.
en/vendor_cheng/2806347e.zh: 布莊老闆今晚在。豆花攤明早才回，有忙就收不了券，要先講好一天幾張。
en/vendor_cheng/2806347e.heard: the fabric shop owner is in tonight the tofu pudding stall won't get back to us till morning they can't take vouchers when it's too busy so agree on a daily cap upfront

en/player_f/32fc2484.text: I'll pull the shop names from the deck for now. I'll snap their storefronts on the way to the Fude Street shrine and check with Ah-Cheng.
en/player_f/32fc2484.zh: 我先把店名從簡報拿掉。沿路我拍一下店門口，去福德街廟口找阿成哥核對。
en/player_f/32fc2484.heard: I'll pull the shop names from the deck for now. I'll snap their storefronts on the way to the Fudo Street Shrine, and check with Acchan.

en/breakfast_auntie/97da3f2d.text: Perfect timing. A customer pointed at that soy sauce ad on TV and asked about it, so I got this bottle out to show them.
en/breakfast_auntie/97da3f2d.zh: 妳來得正好。剛才電視播那支醬油廣告，有客人指著問，我就拿這瓶給他看。
en/breakfast_auntie/97da3f2d.heard: Perfect timing. A customer pointed at that soy sauce ad on TV and asked about it, so I got this bottle out to show them.

en/player_f/56988cf7.text: He's worried they'll pull the display. His boss is worried he'll spend the money and have no order numbers to show for it. No wonder all I got back was a sticker.
en/player_f/56988cf7.zh: 他怕通路撤陳列，老闆怕花了錢還交不出訂單數。難怪他剛才只敢傳貼圖。
en/player_f/56988cf7.heard: He's worried they'll pull the display. His boss is worried he'll spend the money and have no order numbers to show for it. No wonder all I got back was a sticker.

en/player_f/d58d196f.text: I'll get a picture of the bottles. I need to tell the client people might still look for the wrong one if we run the old spot.
en/player_f/d58d196f.zh: 我拍一下瓶子。回去得跟客戶說，舊片照播的話，店裡可能還是有人找錯瓶。
en/player_f/d58d196f.heard: I'll get a picture of the bottles. I need to tell the client people might still look for the wrong one if we run the old spot.

en/tv_su/e4a29b10.text: The boss upstairs says zero TV next year. But we need a signature by eight to keep this slot.
en/tv_su/e4a29b10.zh: 樓上那位說明年電視歸零。可是這張保留單，八點前就得回簽。
en/tv_su/e4a29b10.heard: The boss upstairs says zero TV next year, but we need a signature by eight to keep this slot.

en/player_f/fb29bfa8.text: I'll stop by the convenience store on Songshou Road. Last time we met, he kept asking who actually buys this stuff in stores.
en/player_f/fb29bfa8.zh: 我去松壽路那家超商問問。上次開會，他一直說想知道店裡到底是誰在買。
en/player_f/fb29bfa8.heard: I'll stop by the convenience store on Songshan Road. Last time we met, he kept asking who actually buys this stuff in stores.

en/player_f/e4f6b3d1.text: I just ran a test order. Oat milk was out, so it swapped in regular milk and placed the order without asking.
en/player_f/e4f6b3d1.zh: 我剛跑了一單。燕麥奶缺貨，它換成鮮奶，連問都沒問就送單。
en/player_f/e4f6b3d1.heard: I just ran a test order. Oat milk was out, so it swapped in regular milk and placed the order without asking.

en/tv_su/0200d881.text: The brand manager asked me privately to hang on to it. He promised the retailer a TV spot the week the new bottle hits shelves.
en/tv_su/0200d881.zh: 品牌經理私下拜託我別先放掉。他答應通路，新瓶上架那週會播。
en/tv_su/0200d881.heard: The brand manager asked me privately to hang on to it. He promised the retailer a TV spot the week the new bottle hits shelves.

en/breakfast_auntie/99fca221.text: The red cap's the old one. Yesterday someone came looking for the bottle from TV. The new one was right there and they walked straight past it.
en/breakfast_auntie/99fca221.zh: 紅蓋是舊瓶啦。昨天有客人照電視上的樣子找，新瓶就在旁邊，他沒認出來。
en/breakfast_auntie/99fca221.heard: The red cap's the old one. Yesterday, someone came looking for the bottle from TV. The new one was right there, and they walked straight past it.

en/boss_lin/5ae6e1f6.text: The contract only covers the original buy. Get his signature for any extra spend, and don't promise sales over the phone.
en/boss_lin/5ae6e1f6.zh: 合約只包原本的投放。要加錢就請他簽回來，別在電話裡先答應業績。
en/boss_lin/5ae6e1f6.heard: The contract only covers the original buy. Get his signature for any extra spend. And don't promise sales over the phone.

en/ae_mei/2e2a5a62.text: I checked with creative. The old spot shows the old bottle. A last-minute change to the end card costs extra.
en/ae_mei/2e2a5a62.zh: 我問過創意了，舊片的瓶身跟新包裝不同。今晚臨時換片尾要加錢。
en/ae_mei/2e2a5a62.heard: I checked with creative. The old spot shows the old bottle. A last minute change to the end card costs extra.

en/player_f/334e9958.text: Mei, can you see who’s still online in e-commerce and support? I’ll spell out which line in the announcement needs changing.
en/player_f/334e9958.zh: 美玲姐，幫我確認電商跟客服誰還在線上。我回信會寫清楚哪句公告得改。
en/player_f/334e9958.heard: May, can you see who's still online in e-commerce and support? I'll spell out which line in the announcement needs changing.

en/ae_mei/e80dd870.text: I printed the contract. They signed off on recommendations for this phase, but the announcement says it can buy a replacement if something’s out of stock.
en/ae_mei/e80dd870.zh: 我把合約印出來了。這期簽的是推薦，客戶的公告寫「缺貨也能自動買」耶。
en/ae_mei/e80dd870.heard: I printed the contract. They signed off on recommendations for this phase, but the announcement says they can buy a replacement if something's out of stock.

en/player_f/03846235.text: I'll bring that up first. Ms. Su, how firm was the promise he made to the retailer?
en/player_f/03846235.zh: 這筆我會先講。蘇姐，通路那句「會播」，是答應到哪一步？
en/player_f/03846235.heard: I'll bring that up first. Ms. Hsu, how firm was the promise he made to the retailer?

client_chen/00435733.text: 店員查得到她上次在門市買哪款。客服叫她再拍瓶底，說電話查不到那筆。
client_chen/00435733.heard: 店員查得到他上次在門市買哪一款，客服叫他再拍瓶底，說電話查不到那一筆。

en/breakfast_auntie/65495161.text: Get the one on the right. I used the one on the left to prop up the remote, and the cap's all sticky.
en/breakfast_auntie/65495161.zh: 拍右邊那瓶，左邊那瓶我剛拿來墊遙控器，蓋子黏黏的。
en/breakfast_auntie/65495161.heard: Get the one on the right. I use the one on the left to prop up the remote, and the cap's all sticky.

en/ae_mei/65c93a8e.text: Their e-commerce lead is worried sales will fall flat tomorrow. PR’s already sent the release to the press, so someone will have to call around if it changes.
en/ae_mei/65c93a8e.zh: 他們電商主管怕明天業績開天窗。公關也說新聞稿都給媒體了，臨時改要有人打電話。
en/ae_mei/65c93a8e.heard: Their e-commerce lead is worried sales will fall flat tomorrow. PR's already sent the release to the press, so someone will have to call around if it changes.

en/client_wu/6540fcb7.text: I can take that back to the office. But when my boss asks, what have I got to show him?
en/client_wu/6540fcb7.zh: 這句我可以帶回去。可是老闆問起來，你要我拿什麼給他看？
en/client_wu/6540fcb7.heard: I can take that back to the office, but when my boss asks, what have I got to show him?

en/ae_mei/6975037c.text: The new box just came in. They took out the blue and put the brand name in huge letters on the front.
en/ae_mei/6975037c.zh: 新版盒子樣品寄來了。藍色拿掉，正面換成一個大大的品牌名。
en/ae_mei/6975037c.heard: The new box just came in. They took out the blue and put the brand name in huge letters on the front.

en/boss_lin/5de88f37.text: You’re the AE on this. The client scheduled the launch email for nine tomorrow and wants a yes or no from me.
en/boss_lin/5de88f37.zh: 你是這案的 AE。客戶把明早九點的上線信排好了，要我回一句能不能照發。
en/boss_lin/5de88f37.heard: You're the AE on this. The client scheduled the launch email for 9:00 tomorrow and wants a yes or no from me.

en/tv_su/8472fc29.text: I'll forward the message. You've got time to stop by the breakfast shop on the corner and see how different the bottles look side by side.

en/breakfast_auntie/8b3b4649.text: Go ahead and take a picture. Give it back after, though. I still have to send it to him.
en/breakfast_auntie/8b3b4649.zh: 這張借你拍，拍完還我喔，我等一下還要傳給他。
en/breakfast_auntie/8b3b4649.heard: Go ahead and take a picture. Give it back after though. I still have to send it to him.

en/client_hsu/c3af8c1f.text: My meeting's at five. Give me one sentence I can take in there and say to my boss.
en/client_hsu/c3af8c1f.zh: 我五點要進會議室。你給我一句話，讓我知道該怎麼跟老闆講。
en/client_hsu/c3af8c1f.heard: my meeting's at five. Give me one sentence I can take in there and say to my boss.

en/player_m/5dc15f15.text: He places the order, but you pick the brand. Before you try a new bottle, you want to see how the food will turn out.
en/player_m/5dc15f15.zh: 兒子按下單，您才是挑牌子的。要換一瓶，得讓您先看出滷起來像什麼。
en/player_m/5dc15f15.heard: He places the order, but you pick the brand. Before you try a new bottle, you want to see how the food will turn out.

en/breakfast_auntie/75ef80e2.text: Yep. When they poured it on TV just now, the tofu turned the same color mine does. So I wrote down the brand, too.
en/breakfast_auntie/75ef80e2.zh: 對啊。剛才電視上那瓶一倒下去，豆干的顏色跟我滷的一樣，我才把牌子也抄下來。
en/breakfast_auntie/75ef80e2.heard: Yep, when they poured it on TV just now, the tofu turned the same color mine does, so I wrote down the brand too.

en/vendor_cheng/20610f92.text: They meet friends over by the Earth God shrine after work. Go ask them yourself. I've got a batch to pull out.
en/vendor_cheng/20610f92.zh: 他們下班會在土地公廟那邊等朋友。你去問本人啦，我這鍋要起了。
en/vendor_cheng/20610f92.heard: They meet friends over by the Earth God's shrine after work. Go ask him yourself. I've got a batch to pull out.

en/client_hsu/0536f3e2.text: I told my boss the refills would sell this week. If we pull the sign, he'll ask where the money went.
en/client_hsu/0536f3e2.zh: 我答應老闆補充包這週要有業績。立牌一撤，他一定問我錢花去哪了。
en/client_hsu/0536f3e2.heard: I told my boss the refills would sell this week. If we pull the sign, he'll ask where the money went.

en/player_f/5f62c169.text: Mr. Wu, this one counts everyone in the station. Your shop's at Exit 4, so let's pull out the traffic that actually comes this way.
en/player_f/5f62c169.zh: 吳經理，這張算的是整站人流。我們門市在四號出口，先把走這邊的人拉出來算。
en/player_f/5f62c169.heard: Mr. Woo, this one counts everyone in the station. Your shop's at exit four, so let's pull up the traffic that actually comes this way.

en/client_wu/4573c586.text: Should I just buy the two busiest morning spots? My boss wants commuters to see us at least twice this week.
en/client_wu/4573c586.zh: 那我先買兩個早上最熱鬧的版位？老闆希望通勤的人這週至少看到兩次。
en/client_wu/4573c586.heard: Should I just buy the two busiest morning spots? My boss wants commuters to see us at least twice this week.

en/breakfast_auntie/ed8746aa.text: “Yellow cap.” Last time my son ordered on his phone, he got the red cap. One bite of the braised tofu and I could tell he’d switched it.
en/breakfast_auntie/ed8746aa.zh: 我寫「黃蓋」。上次我兒子用手機買，挑到紅蓋的，滷豆干一入口我就知道換了。
en/breakfast_auntie/ed8746aa.heard: Yellow cap. Last time my son ordered on his phone, he got the red cap. One bite of the braised tofu, and I could tell he'd switched it.

en/player_m/c3285e27.text: I'll put the tasting survey next to our notes from the exit. First we need to pick what we want this Americano launch to prove.
en/player_m/c3285e27.zh: 我先把試喝表和出口筆記放一起。熱美式這一檔，我們得先選要證明哪件事。
en/player_m/c3285e27.heard: I'll put the tasting survey next to our notes from the exit. First, we need to pick what we want this Americano launch to prove.

en/player_m/0875c5fe.text: I asked what she was doing this weekend. She wants to take the bus to Yongkang Street herself so her daughter won't have to take time off to drive her again.
en/player_m/0875c5fe.zh: 我問她週末去哪。她說想自己搭公車去永康街，省得女兒又請假載她。
en/player_m/0875c5fe.heard: I asked what she was doing this weekend. She wants to take the bus to Yongkang Street herself, so her daughter won't have to take time off to drive her again.

en/player_f/849e2050.text: If both spots are on the same route, the same people might see us twice. I'll estimate reach and frequency separately.
en/player_f/849e2050.zh: 兩個版位如果都在同一條路上，可能是同一批人連看兩次。我把觸及和頻次分開估。
en/player_f/849e2050.heard: If both spots are on the same route the same people might see us twice. I'll estimate reach and frequency separately.

en/clerk_ning/81ff3024.text: The guy in rain boots this morning? He put his empty tube on the counter and asked for another blue one before he got off work.
en/clerk_ning/81ff3024.zh: 早上那個穿雨鞋的喔？他把舊的空管放桌上，說下班前要再拿一條藍色的。
en/clerk_ning/81ff3024.heard: The guy in rain boots this morning? He put his empty tube on the counter and asked for another blue one before he got off work.

en/boss_lin/d18666b6.text: Searches for Itch Be Gone are down. HQ wants to see orders this week.
en/boss_lin/d18666b6.zh: 腳癢退散的搜尋量掉了。總公司說，這週要看到訂單。
en/boss_lin/d18666b6.heard: searches for Itch-B-Gone are down. HQ wants to see orders this week.

en/clerk_ning/79742ad1.text: Itch Be Gone? It's been raining for days. We sell the most in the after-work rush.
en/clerk_ning/79742ad1.zh: 腳癢退散喔？這幾天下雨，下班那一波買最多。
en/clerk_ning/79742ad1.heard: It should be gone. It's been raining for days. We sell the most in the after-work rush.

en/client_wu/e24dd78a.text: Look at these. One's a monthly rate, one's priced by plays per day, and the cheapest quote is two lines long. How am I supposed to compare them?
en/client_wu/e24dd78a.zh: 你看，這張寫包月，這張寫一天播幾次。最便宜那張才兩行，我要怎麼比？
en/client_wu/e24dd78a.heard: Look at this. One's a monthly rate, one's priced by place per day, and the cheapest quote is two lines long. How am I supposed to compare them?

en/data_kai/6f05d8f1.text: The screen quote counts plays. Finance will kick it back if you put those in the same column as search clicks.
en/data_kai/6f05d8f1.zh: 看板報的是播放次數。你拿那欄跟搜尋的點擊比，會被財務退件。
en/data_kai/6f05d8f1.heard: The screen quote counts plays. Finance will kick it back if you put those in the same column as search clicks.

en/cd_wei/b7261205.text: Elephant Mountain View Realty just sent a screenshot. Their boss asked in the group chat who viewers should call to book a viewing after the ad.
en/cd_wei/b7261205.zh: 象山看得到房屋剛傳來一張截圖。老闆在群組問，片子播完，要看房的人打給誰？
en/cd_wei/b7261205.heard: Elephant Mountain View Realty just sent a screenshot. Their boss asked in the group chat who viewers should call to book a viewing after the ad.

en/data_kai/33afc15c.text: The stores can export cup sales in half-hour blocks. Send me the ad times and I'll check the numbers each morning.
en/data_kai/33afc15c.zh: 門市能匯出每半小時賣幾杯。你把時段給我，我可以每天早上對一次。
en/data_kai/33afc15c.heard: The stores can export cup sales in half-hour blocks. Send me the ad times, and I'll check the numbers each morning.

en/player_f/c6955107.text: Are people finding the store on their phones, or are they passing by anyway?
en/player_f/c6955107.zh: 他們是看手機找來的，還是本來就會經過這裡？
en/player_f/c6955107.heard: Are people finding the store on their phones, or are they passing by anyway?

en/boss_lin/b5c5637f.text: The corner store on Songshou Road stocks it. Get back to me by noon. That's how long they'll hold the slots.
en/boss_lin/b5c5637f.zh: 松壽路巷口那家有賣。中午前回我，版位只留到那時候。
en/boss_lin/b5c5637f.heard: the corner store on Songshu Road stocks it. Get back to me by noon, that's how long they'll hold the slots.

en/player_f/0b873ac9.text: Got it. Do you track sales for the morning and evening shifts separately?
en/player_f/0b873ac9.zh: 原來如此。那早班跟晚班賣的量，你們有分開記嗎？
en/player_f/0b873ac9.heard: Got it. Do you track sales for the morning and evening shifts separately?

en/temple_uncle/e746c684.text: Ah-Cheng's by the red chairs with the shopkeepers' reply slips. You saw how narrow it is in front of the ice shop on your way here, right?
en/temple_uncle/e746c684.zh: 阿成在紅椅子那邊，手上那張就是店家回條。妳剛走過來，有看到冰店門口多窄吧？
en/temple_uncle/e746c684.heard: Ah Cheng's by the red chairs with the shopkeeper's reply slips. You saw how narrow it is in front of the ice shop on your way here, right?

en/clerk_ning/fa626f89.text: Sure, I can pull that from the register. I've got the dry days too. Which dates do you want?
en/clerk_ning/fa626f89.zh: 有啊，收銀機可以拉。晴天也有，你要哪幾天？
en/clerk_ning/fa626f89.heard: Sure. I can pull that from the register. I've got the dry dates too. Which dates do you want?

en/boss_lin/07bb79d5.text: We've got quotes for search ads and digital screens by the MRT exits. That's all the spare budget we've got.
en/boss_lin/07bb79d5.zh: 搜尋跟捷運出口的電子看板都有報價。機動預算就這筆。
en/boss_lin/07bb79d5.heard: We've got quotes for search ads and digital screens by the MRT exits. That's all the spare budget we've got.

en/data_kai/58b40914.text: Just impressions. Add up both platforms and you have no idea how often you've counted the same person.
en/data_kai/58b40914.zh: 只有曝光。兩家平台的數字直接加，你連同一個人被算了幾次都不知道。
en/data_kai/58b40914.heard: just impressions. Add up both platforms, and you have no idea how often you've counted the same person.

en/player_f/4f52d727.text: I'll ask the store who's buying and when they come in. Then I'll know which hours are worth pricing out.
en/player_f/4f52d727.zh: 我先問門市是誰在買、幾點進店。要不然我連該比哪個時段都不知道。
en/player_f/4f52d727.heard: I'll ask the store who's buying and when they come in. Then, I'll know which hours are worth pricing out.

en/clerk_ning/a2a9908c.text: A few regulars walk over from the MRT. They ask which aisle it's in before they've even folded their umbrellas.
en/clerk_ning/a2a9908c.zh: 幾個熟客從捷運走過來，雨傘都還沒收，就直接問我放哪一排。
en/clerk_ning/a2a9908c.heard: A few regulars walk over from the MRT. They ask which aisle it's in before they've even folded their umbrellas.

en/player_f/8fdb9e69.text: I'll ask the rep to hold the takeover until noon. We can split search by day, so I'd like to check when orders actually came in last year.
en/player_f/8fdb9e69.zh: 我先請業務把包版留到中午。搜尋那張能按天拆，我想先看去年哪幾個時段真的有單。
en/player_f/8fdb9e69.heard: I'll ask the rep to hold the takeover until noon. We can split search by days, so I'd like to check when orders actually came in last year.

en/ae_mei/167f52b0.text: The contract only budgets for one launch. The client's worried HQ might pull the money and wants a confirmed list tonight.
en/ae_mei/167f52b0.zh: 合約只編了一場開幕的錢。客戶怕總部抽預算，問我們今晚能不能給一份確定名單。
en/ae_mei/167f52b0.heard: The contract only budgets for one launch. The client's worried HQ might pull the money and wants a confirmed list tonight.

en/player_f/dc82807a.text: Let me pull up the quotes. If we put it all into prime time, there's nothing left for weekend search.
en/player_f/dc82807a.zh: 我先拉報價。這筆錢全買晚間檔，週末的搜尋預算就沒了。
en/player_f/dc82807a.heard: Let me pull up the quotes. If we put it all into prime time, there's nothing left for weekend search.

en/player_f/37f0d15e.text: Okay, I'll add printing costs and guaranteed plays to the sheet. Which plan are we circling before we send it at nine?
en/player_f/37f0d15e.zh: 好，我把印刷費跟保證播放次數補進表裡。九點前要送的那張，先圈哪一案？
en/player_f/37f0d15e.heard: Okay, I'll add printing costs and guaranteed plays to the sheet. Which plan are we circling before we send it at 9:00?

en/player_f/aeaa835d.text: Got it. I'll put the frequency caps and placement rates on page four of tonight's pitch.
en/player_f/aeaa835d.zh: 好，我把頻次上限跟各版位的單價一起列在今晚比稿的第四頁。
en/player_f/aeaa835d.heard: Got it. I'll put the frequency caps and placement rates on page four of tonight's pitch.

en/client_chen/332105f3.text: Look at these two quotes. Friday night's video takeover or the weekend search budget. Finance says we can keep one.
en/client_chen/332105f3.zh: 妳看這兩張報價。週五晚上的影音包版，跟週末的搜尋預算，財務說只能留一張。
en/client_chen/332105f3.heard: Look at these two quotes: Friday night's video takeover or the weekend search budget. Finance says we can keep one.

en/player_f/ace4810f.text: Okay, I'll list cost per thousand impressions and cost per order separately. If we test by region, can you pull the orders for each one?
en/player_f/ace4810f.zh: 好，我把每千次曝光的價跟每筆訂單的成本分開列。分區試投的話，你幫我拉各區的訂單。
en/player_f/ace4810f.heard: Okay, I'll list cost per thousand impressions and cost per order separately. If we test by region, can you pull the orders for each one?

en/data_kai/c2da5d1e.text: Last time all three placements shared one QR code. I could see the scans, but I couldn’t tell which screen they came from.
en/data_kai/c2da5d1e.zh: 上次三個版位共用一個 QR Code。有人掃，我也不知道是從哪塊螢幕來的。
en/data_kai/c2da5d1e.heard: Last time, all three placements shared one QR code. I could see the scans, but I couldn't tell which screen they came from.

en/data_kai/6e3ef7e6.text: Last year, most orders came in after dinner on Friday, when the add-on deal went live. See? Saturday morning is practically blank.
en/data_kai/6e3ef7e6.zh: 去年加購優惠一開，訂單都擠在週五晚餐後。妳看，週六早上這欄幾乎是空的。
en/data_kai/6e3ef7e6.heard: Last year, most orders came in after dinner on Friday when the add-on deal went live, see? Saturday morning is practically blank.

en/client_chen/64f98ac3.text: Impressions were cheap last time, but a coworker saw the same ad five times in one night. Now my boss only wants to see orders.
en/client_chen/64f98ac3.zh: 上次包版的曝光很便宜，同事卻說他一個晚上看到五次。老闆現在只肯看訂單。
en/client_chen/64f98ac3.heard: Impressions were cheap last time, but a coworker saw the same ad five times in one night. Now my boss only wants to see orders.

en/player_f/97312684.text: For reach, I want to know how many people saw it. For bookings, I'll ask the branch to log which ones actually got confirmed.
en/player_f/97312684.zh: 看觸及就得問看到了多少人。要算預約，我會請門市回填哪些真的有約成。
en/player_f/97312684.heard: For reach, I want to know how many people saw it. For bookings, I'll ask the branch to log which ones actually got confirmed.

en/cd_wei/072d1f42.text: I'll leave the 30-second master on your desk. If we're running online video, the editor can still export it today.
en/cd_wei/072d1f42.zh: 那我把三十秒的母帶放妳桌上。要跑網路影音，剪接師今天還能幫忙出檔。
en/cd_wei/072d1f42.heard: I'll leave the 30-second master on your desk. If we're running online video, the editor can still export it today.

en/client_hsu/0154782b.text: Look, we haven’t even opened these two cases of refills. I’ve got NT$60,000 left, and my boss wants results on Monday.
en/client_hsu/0154782b.zh: 你看，這兩箱補充包還沒拆。我只剩六萬，週一老闆就要看成績。
en/client_hsu/0154782b.heard: Look, we haven't even opened these two cases of refills. I've got $60,000 left, and my boss wants results on Monday.

en/client_hsu/ca0efbfe.text: The rep says the screen by the elevators will play our ad 80 times a day. Is that a good deal?
en/client_hsu/ca0efbfe.zh: 館內電梯口那面螢幕，業務說一天播八十次。這樣算划算嗎？
en/client_hsu/ca0efbfe.heard: The rep says the screen by the elevators will play our ad 80 times a day. Is that a good deal?

en/cd_wei/a1bf7fdf.text: Look, the client crossed out the MRT lightboxes. We've still got the money, but the station will only hold that 8 PM slot until four.
en/cd_wei/a1bf7fdf.zh: 妳看，房仲把捷運燈箱那列畫掉了。預算還在，晚間八點的電視檔只留到四點。
en/cd_wei/a1bf7fdf.heard: Look, the client crossed out the MRT light boxes. We've still got the money, but the station will only hold that 8:00 p.m. slot until 4:00.

en/cd_wei/bcded723.text: Come here a sec. Sales says bookings are down because nobody knows we do virtual viewings.
en/cd_wei/bcded723.zh: 快來，業務說預約少是因為大家不知道我們有線上帶看。
en/cd_wei/bcded723.heard: Come here a sec. Sales says bookings are down because nobody knows we do virtual viewings.

en/client_hsu/3e3596a8.text: Let’s track them separately this time. I need to be able to explain what we paid for when I show my boss the numbers on Monday.
en/client_hsu/3e3596a8.zh: 那這次分開算吧。週一那張表，我至少得講得清楚錢買到了什麼。
en/client_hsu/3e3596a8.heard: Let's track them separately this time. I need to be able to explain what we paid for when I show my boss the numbers on Monday.

en/player_f/de9bccaa.text: That’s 80 plays. I’ll ask for weekday and weekend foot traffic so we can compare rates.
en/player_f/de9bccaa.zh: 八十次是播幾遍。我再問他平日和週末各有多少人經過，才知道怎麼比價。
en/player_f/de9bccaa.heard: That's 80 places. I'll ask for weekday and weekend foot traffic, so we can compare rates.

en/data_kai/399f9ce4.text: They need a signature by four thirty. Send me the media plan so I know which columns to pull tomorrow.
en/data_kai/399f9ce4.zh: 四點半要回簽。你把投放表給我，我就知道明天要拉哪幾欄。
en/data_kai/399f9ce4.heard: They need a signature by 4:30. Send me the media plan so I know which columns to pull tomorrow

en/player_f/ee31630d.text: The screen package costs more, but it gets us the evening commute. With chat ads we can cap how often people see them or pile into lunch.
en/player_f/ee31630d.zh: 螢幕包檔比較貴，能碰到下班人潮。對話版位可以限頻，也能集中買午休。
en/player_f/ee31630d.heard: The screen package costs more, but it gets us the evening commute. With chat ads, we can cap how often people see them or pile into lunch.

en/ae_mei/d7d7c457.text: Okay. I’m putting one media plan in tonight’s pitch. The vendor’s waiting to hear about that eight o’clock slot.
en/ae_mei/d7d7c457.zh: 行，今晚比稿我只放一張媒體表。看板八點的檔期，廠商等我們回覆。
en/ae_mei/d7d7c457.heard: Okay, I'm putting one media plan in tonight's pitch. The vendor is waiting to hear about that 8:00 slot.

en/player_f/8e11b821.text: I've got a quote for screens at the MRT exits. There's a lunch slot in the chatbot too. Booking both in full puts us over budget.
en/player_f/8e11b821.zh: 我這邊有捷運出口的螢幕報價。對話廣告也有午休檔，兩邊全買會超支。
en/player_f/8e11b821.heard: I've got a quote for screens at the MRT exits. There's a lunch slot in the top bar, too. Booking both in full puts us over budget.

en/temple_uncle/9acb92c7.text: You were looking at the fabric shop sign, huh? They pull the shutter down at seven-thirty.
en/temple_uncle/9acb92c7.zh: 妳剛剛在看布莊的招牌喔？他們七點半就拉鐵門了。
en/temple_uncle/9acb92c7.heard: You were looking at the fabric shop sign, huh? They pulled the shutter down at 7:30.

en/boss_lin/596d6d78.text: Give me one line. The pitch client is already seated next door and slide nine is still blank.
en/boss_lin/596d6d78.zh: 先定一句。比稿客戶在隔壁坐好了，我們第九頁還空著。
en/boss_lin/596d6d78.heard: Give me one line. The pitch client is already seated next door, and slide nine is still blank.

en/ae_mei/cb384b67.text: I just got off the phone with the client. She wants to know how many people see the new drink. The store manager just wants to know how many extra cups he'll sell.
en/ae_mei/cb384b67.zh: 我剛跟客戶通完電話。她要看新品被多少人看到，店長只問能多賣幾杯。
en/ae_mei/cb384b67.heard: I just got off the phone with the client. She wants to know how many people see the new drink. The store manager just wants to know how many extra cups he'll sell.

en/player_f/00f10e0a.text: Eight is the priciest slot, but the quote only says how many times the ad plays. I want to see who actually looks up.
en/player_f/00f10e0a.zh: 入口看板八點最貴，但報價只寫播幾次。路過的人有沒有抬頭，我得去看一下。
en/player_f/00f10e0a.heard: Eight is the priciest slot, but the quote only says how many times the ad plays. I want to see who actually looks up

en/ae_mei/1e051f37.text: One Less Piece opens next week. This quote is for the screen at the night market entrance. The other’s for mobile ads. We can’t afford both.
en/ae_mei/1e051f37.zh: 少一件下週開幕。這張是夜市入口的電子看板，另一張是手機廣告，兩張加起來超預算。
en/ae_mei/1e051f37.heard: One Last Piece opens next week. This quote is for the screen at the Night Market entrance, the other's for mobile ads. We can't afford both.

en/player_m/b185b870.text: My sticky note said “not strong enough.” Now I want to know how many minutes they'd spare for coffee.
en/player_m/b185b870.zh: 我在便利貼上本來寫「嫌不夠濃」。現在我想問，他們肯留幾分鐘買咖啡？
en/player_m/b185b870.heard: My sticky note said, not strong enough. Now, I want to know how many minutes they'd spare for coffee.

en/client_hsu/4c1c6187.text: My boss already put that planet line on slide one. What are you bringing him tomorrow morning?
en/client_hsu/4c1c6187.zh: 那句友善地球，我主管已經放在簡報第一頁了。你明早打算拿什麼跟他談？
en/client_hsu/4c1c6187.heard: My boss already put that planet line on slide one. What are you bringing him tomorrow morning?

en/boss_lin/01b4ce3f.text: It goes to print at noon. You're the strategist. Who needs to see the name that big?
en/boss_lin/01b4ce3f.zh: 中午要印了。你是策略企劃，先告訴我，這名字放大給誰看？
en/boss_lin/01b4ce3f.heard: It goes to print at noon. You're the strategist. Who needs to see the name that big?

en/data_kai/388df49c.text: I’ve got both quotes open. The screen quote is for ad plays. The mobile one estimates reach and frequency.
en/data_kai/388df49c.zh: 我把兩張報價攤開了。看板賣的是播出次數，手機那張有估觸及和頻次。
en/data_kai/388df49c.heard: I've got both quotes open. The screen quote is for ad plays. The mobile one estimates reach and frequency.

en/player_f/eec54d88.text: Sure. I’ve got quotes here for store search ads, the mall screen, and the MRT entrance screen with short videos. Let’s put the NT$60,000 behind one of them.
en/player_f/eec54d88.zh: 好，我把電商搜尋、館內螢幕跟站口加短影音的報價都攤在這，六萬先押一邊。
en/player_f/eec54d88.heard: Sure. I've got quotes here for store search ads, the mall screen, and the MRT entrance screen with short videos. Let's put the NT 60,000 behind one of them.

en/player_f/5483cf20.text: I’ll walk down to the shrine on Fude Street and see which shops are still open along the way.
en/player_f/5483cf20.zh: 我走到福德街廟口看看，順便記一下沿路哪幾家店還開著。
en/player_f/5483cf20.heard: I'll walk down to the shrine on Futa Street and see which shops are still open along the way.

en/player_f/ae3a7ea7.text: So you're the one watching at noon. Where do you buy noodles for the shop?
en/player_f/ae3a7ea7.zh: 原來中午是妳在看。那妳補店裡的麵，都是去哪裡買？
en/player_f/ae3a7ea7.heard: So, you're the one watching at noon. Where do you buy noodles for the shop?

en/player_f/47577ca1.text: Yeah. The screen at the entrance kept playing. The only people I saw look up were waiting for fried chicken.
en/player_f/47577ca1.zh: 對，入口那塊螢幕一直在播，我一路只看到等鹹酥雞的人抬頭。
en/player_f/47577ca1.heard: Yeah, the screen at the entrance kept playing. The only people I saw look up were waiting for fried chicken.

en/player_f/4455b9fc.text: Can you break up the prime-time package first? I need separate rates for the noon news and the evening rerun.
en/player_f/4455b9fc.zh: 先把八點檔拆開報。我要午間新聞跟晚間重播各自的單價。
en/player_f/4455b9fc.heard: Can you break up the primetime package first? I need separate rates for the noon news and the evening rerun.

en/player_f/fb8bf15b.text: Got it. I'll compare the cost per thousand impressions for the same age group, then check how many people we'd reach more than once.
en/player_f/fb8bf15b.zh: 好，我用同一個年齡層比每千次曝光成本，再看有多少人會重複看到。
en/player_f/fb8bf15b.heard: Got it. I'll compare the cost per thousand impressions for the same age group, then check how many people we'd reach more than once.

en/data_kai/f6bbdb32.text: Look at this screenshot. Someone asked what to drink after lunch in Xinyi, and the chatbot sent them next door.
en/data_kai/f6bbdb32.zh: 你看這張截圖。有人問信義區午餐後喝什麼，聊天助手推了隔壁那家。
en/data_kai/f6bbdb32.heard: Look at this screenshot. Someone asked what to drink after lunch in Xinyi, and the chatbot sent them next door.

en/player_f/b6f9a668.text: I'll price out search for after dinner, then. Does this video quote say how many people it'll reach?
en/player_f/b6f9a668.zh: 那搜尋先估晚餐後的價。影音這張報價有寫觸及人數嗎？
en/player_f/b6f9a668.heard: I'll pause our search for after dinner, then. Does this video quote say how many people it'll reach?

en/cd_wei/cf5737f5.text: So should I shelve that photo of the mom and daughter holding hands? The client called it moving just this afternoon.
en/cd_wei/cf5737f5.zh: 那我那張母女牽手照先收起來？客戶下午才說很感人耶。
en/cd_wei/cf5737f5.heard: So, should I shelve that photo of the mom and daughter holding hands? The client called it moving just this afternoon.

en/tv_su/12f12fe6.text: The retailer's chasing us too. Their package for sponsored search and add-on placements expires tonight. Where do you want the money to go?
en/tv_su/12f12fe6.zh: 通路也來催，站內搜尋跟加購版位的套裝今晚截止。你這筆錢想留給誰？
en/tv_su/12f12fe6.heard: The retailer is chasing us too. Their package for sponsored search and add-on placements expires tonight. Where do you want the money to go?

en/tv_su/7c7a335b.text: The rerun costs less per spot, but some people watch both. Watch for overlap when you run the reach numbers.
en/tv_su/7c7a335b.zh: 重播單價低，但有些人兩個時段都看。你回去算觸及時要留意。
en/tv_su/7c7a335b.heard: The rerun costs less per spot, but some people watch both. Watch for overlap when you run the reach numbers.

en/boss_lin/8bd38afa.text: The client's already put “Buy it for your parents” on the cover. Anything you'd change after watching the interview?
en/boss_lin/8bd38afa.zh: 客戶把「買給爸媽」印在提案封面了。你看完訪談，有要改嗎？
en/boss_lin/8bd38afa.heard: The client's already put "Buy it for your parents" on the cover. Anything you'd change after watching the interview?

en/breakfast_auntie/76d2e87c.text: I pick up a whole case at the supermarket around the corner. The girl on the evening shift usually shops on her phone and adds stuff until shipping's free.
en/breakfast_auntie/76d2e87c.zh: 我去巷口超市搬整箱啊。晚班那個妹妹倒是常用手機湊免運。
en/breakfast_auntie/76d2e87c.heard: I pick up a whole case at the supermarket around the corner. The girl on the evening shift usually shops on her phone and adds stuff until shipping's free.

en/player_f/bef94e8b.text: I'll split noon and evening on the schedule. Same TV, different people watching and buying.
en/player_f/bef94e8b.zh: 我先在排期表把午間跟晚間拆開。同一台電視，看的跟下單的還真不一樣。
en/player_f/bef94e8b.heard: A split noon and evening on the schedule. Same TV, different people watching and buying.

en/player_f/7bcb760a.text: I’ll keep those units separate. I’ll give the redemptions we can verify at the register their own column, too.
en/player_f/7bcb760a.zh: 那我先把兩種單位分開。店裡能對到的兌換，也另外算一欄。
en/player_f/7bcb760a.heard: I'll keep those units separate. I'll give the redemptions we can verify at the register their own column, too.

en/client_wu/41a6a8ff.text: Good timing. I printed the proof. Everything circled in red is something my boss wants bigger.
en/client_wu/41a6a8ff.zh: 你來得正好。我把稿印出來了，紅筆圈的地方，老闆都要放大。
en/client_wu/41a6a8ff.heard: Good timing. I printed the proof. Everything circled in red is something my boss wants bigger.

en/tv_su/8d361ae8.text: They're waiting upstairs for your launch schedule. Procurement cleared NT$300,000. Five nights in the 8 p.m. drama slot would eat the whole thing.
en/tv_su/8d361ae8.zh: 樓上等你排首週。採購只批三十萬，八點檔連買五晚就花光了。
en/tv_su/8d361ae8.heard: They're waiting upstairs for your launch schedule. Procurement cleared 300,000. Five nights in the 8:00 p.m. drama slot would eat the whole thing.

en/client_wu/dacd1817.text: Try looking from the far end of the escalator. Can you make out anything besides the price?
en/client_wu/dacd1817.zh: 你站到手扶梯那頭看。除了價錢，你還看得到什麼？
en/client_wu/dacd1817.heard: Try looking from the far end of the escalator. Uh can you make out anything besides the price?

en/player_f/c4783de1.text: Auntie Hsiu-chin, is this the channel you have on when you're prepping at noon?
en/player_f/c4783de1.zh: 秀琴姨，妳中午備料也看這一台嗎？
en/player_f/c4783de1.heard: Auntie Xiaoqing, is this the channel you have on when you're prepping at noon?

en/boss_lin/52c2c077.text: That's all we've got for the face wash launch. They'll release the MRT slots at 9:10.
en/boss_lin/52c2c077.zh: 洗面乳首週的錢就這些。捷運那張報價單，九點十分就不留位了。
en/boss_lin/52c2c077.heard: That's all we've got for the face wash launch. They'll release the MRT slots at 9:10.

en/cd_wei/8f9ecda5.text: I saw your sketch. Can you really make the train doors turn into a coffee cup as they close?
en/cd_wei/8f9ecda5.zh: 我看過你那張草圖。車門合起來變成杯身，做得出來嗎？
en/cd_wei/8f9ecda5.heard: I saw your sketch. Can you really make the train doors turn into a coffee cup as they close?

en/player_f/910fe032.text: All I can see of the cup is a sliver of white. But a few people just looked up when they heard the doors closing.
en/player_f/910fe032.zh: 杯子只剩一條白邊。剛剛倒是有好幾個人聽到關門聲就抬頭。
en/player_f/910fe032.heard: All I can see of the cup is a sliver of white, but a few people just looked up when they heard the doors closing.

en/tv_su/0873ad07.text: Meeting upstairs in twenty. Stop by Auntie Hsiu-chin's place on Wuxing Street first. She turns on the TV when she starts prepping.
en/tv_su/0873ad07.zh: 樓上二十分鐘後開會。先去吳興街問秀琴姨，她那台電視從備料就開著。
en/tv_su/0873ad07.heard: Meeting upstairs in 20. Stop by Auntie Xiuqin's place on Wuxing Street first. She turns on the TV when she starts prepping.

en/data_kai/a6bf8364.text: Last time the short videos ran seven times per person on average, and reach still stalled. More money might just buy more of the same audience.
en/data_kai/a6bf8364.zh: 上波短影音頻次都到七了，觸及還是沒長。再加錢，可能又是同一群人在看。
en/data_kai/a6bf8364.heard: Last time the short videos ran seven times per person on average, and reach still stalled. More money might just buy more of the same audience.

en/player_f/5f08b94a.text: I just put all three quotes on a cost-per-thousand basis. If I sign for the MRT package, I'll have to cut the evening shopping ads.
en/player_f/5f08b94a.zh: 我剛把三張報價都換算成每千次曝光成本。捷運包檔一簽，晚上的購物廣告就得砍。
en/player_f/5f08b94a.heard: I just put all three quotes on a cost-per-thousand basis. If I sign for the MRT package, I'll have to cut the evening shopping ads.

en/player_f/8931a270.text: Did he grab the cream right after that?
en/player_f/8931a270.zh: 他倒完水就去拿藥膏喔？
en/player_f/8931a270.heard: Did he grab the cream right after that?

en/player_f/b38f3af8.text: I'll put a frequency cap in the plan. Ah-Kai, can we hold back one group from the video ads? I want to see how many extra orders we get.
en/player_f/b38f3af8.zh: 那我先把頻次上限填進表。阿凱，短影音能留一組不投嗎？我想看多帶了幾張單。
en/player_f/b38f3af8.heard: I'll put a frequency cap in the plan. Okay, can we hold back one group from the video ads? I want to see how many extra orders we get.

en/player_f/0e18f296.text: I'll go take a look. The store might have the shot we're missing.
en/player_f/0e18f296.zh: 我去看一下，搞不好店裡就有我們缺的那顆鏡頭。
en/player_f/0e18f296.heard: I'll go take a look. The storm might have the shot we're missing.

en/breakfast_auntie/44f0f13c.text: I watch the news at noon. The evening rerun's for people waiting on their food. See that table? They're still waiting for their egg crepes.
en/breakfast_auntie/44f0f13c.zh: 中午我看新聞，晚上重播是留給等餐的客人啦。你看，那桌還在等蛋餅。
en/breakfast_auntie/44f0f13c.heard: I watch the news at noon. The evening rerun's for people waiting on their food. See that table? They're still waiting for their egg crepes.

en/client_wu/b200071a.text: We can only greenlight one today. Show me what you've got and I'll take it to my boss this afternoon.
en/client_wu/b200071a.zh: 今天只能定一套。你讓我看一遍，我下午帶去跟老闆講。
en/client_wu/b200071a.heard: We can only green-light one today. Show me what you've got and I'll take it to my boss this afternoon.

en/temple_uncle/a2f864d3.text: People heading home from work take the covered sidewalk. They’re past the shrine by six or so. The eight o’clock crowd comes for a late bite.
en/temple_uncle/a2f864d3.zh: 下班的人走騎樓，六點多就從廟前過去了。八點來的是吃宵夜的。
en/temple_uncle/a2f864d3.heard: People heading home from work take the covered sidewalk. They're past the shrine by six or so. The 8:00 crowd comes for a late bite.

en/clerk_ning/d631e386.text: He stuffed his wet socks into one of our plastic bags first. Then he came over and asked where we kept the cream.
en/clerk_ning/d631e386.zh: 他先拿超商塑膠袋把濕襪子裝起來，才過來問藥膏放哪。
en/clerk_ning/d631e386.heard: He stuffed his wet socks into one of our plastic bags first, then he came over and asked where we kept the cream.

en/player_f/6dec51f5.text: I'll shoot a test with a paper cup and two gray boards. If we lead with the deal, I'll cut a separate version.
en/player_f/6dec51f5.zh: 我先用紙杯和兩塊灰卡拍給你看。要賣折扣的話，我會另外剪一版。
en/player_f/6dec51f5.heard: I'll shoot a test with a paper cup and two gray boards. If we lead with the deal, I'll cut a separate version.

en/clerk_ning/8fbd6c4d.text: A delivery guy came in this morning, stood by that red chair, and poured water out of his rain boots.
en/clerk_ning/8fbd6c4d.zh: 早班有個送貨大哥，站在那張紅椅旁邊，把雨鞋裡的水倒出來。
en/clerk_ning/8fbd6c4d.heard: A delivery guy came in this morning, stood by that red chair, and poured water out of his rain boots.

en/clerk_ning/ded01e20.text: Second shelf to the right of the register. You can shoot the shelf, just keep customers' faces out of frame.
en/clerk_ning/ded01e20.zh: 櫃台右邊第二格。現場可以拍貨架，客人的臉別入鏡喔。
en/clerk_ning/ded01e20.heard: Second shelf to the right of the register. You can shoot the shelf, just keep customers' faces out of frame.

en/boss_lin/9d1ed0d6.text: Searches for Itch Be Gone are down. HQ wants the tube on screen in the first second.
en/boss_lin/9d1ed0d6.zh: 腳癢退散的搜尋掉了。總公司要藥膏第一秒就出現。
en/boss_lin/9d1ed0d6.heard: searches for Itch-B-Gone are down. HQ wants the tube on screen in the first second.

en/ae_mei/86f3db70.text: The client just messaged me on LINE. Can people book a virtual viewing straight from the ad?
en/ae_mei/86f3db70.zh: 客戶剛在 LINE 問我，這支能不能讓人直接預約視訊看屋？
en/ae_mei/86f3db70.heard: The client just messaged me on LINE. Can people book a virtual viewing straight from the ad?

en/client_chen/ef2663f1.text: That woman at the start opens her paper bag outside the pharmacy. My boss wants to know why our bottle isn't on screen in the first second.
en/client_chen/ef2663f1.zh: 片頭那個阿姨，站在藥局門外把紙袋攤開。老闆問我，為什麼第一秒還沒看到我們的罐子？
en/client_chen/ef2663f1.heard: That woman at the start opens her paper bag outside the pharmacy. My boss wants to know why our bottle isn't on screen in the first second.

en/cd_wei/abb95045.text: I remember those boots you drew. Will people know where to buy the stuff, though?
en/cd_wei/abb95045.zh: 你畫那雙雨鞋我有印象。只是客人看得出來去哪買嗎？
en/cd_wei/abb95045.heard: I remember those boots you drew. Will people know where to buy the stuff, though?

en/player_f/bb7949ab.text: We could keep the bit where he ties the bag. Which shelf is it on? Mind if I get a shot?
en/player_f/bb7949ab.zh: 塑膠袋打結那一下可以留下來。藥膏放哪一格，我可以拍一下嗎？
en/player_f/bb7949ab.heard: Okay, we could keep the bit where he ties the bag. Which shelf is it on? Mind if I get a shot?

en/player_f/8d70492f.text: She's digging out the bottle she bought by mistake last time. It's that crumpled receipt I want to keep in the shot.
en/player_f/8d70492f.zh: 她在翻上次買錯的那罐。那張皺掉的收據，是我想留的鏡頭。
en/player_f/8d70492f.heard: She's digging out the bottle she bought by mistake last time. It's that crumpled receipt I want to keep in the shot.

en/data_kai/c23d9c56.text: The orders tell us what sold. For questions, you need the shift log. Here's one: a customer brought in an empty bottle to ask if it was the same product.
en/data_kai/c23d9c56.zh: 訂單看得到哪款賣掉，問過什麼得翻門市交班簿。這裡有一條，客人帶空罐來問是不是同一款。
en/data_kai/c23d9c56.heard: The orders tell us what's sold. For questions, you need the shift log. Here's one. A customer brought in an empty bottle to ask if it was the same product.

en/ae_mei/91a6adb1.text: Two people is enough for a hunch. The client has to settle on a launch tonight. Which idea are you asking them to back?
en/ae_mei/91a6adb1.zh: 兩個人夠你寫假設。客戶今晚就要定開幕，你這頁要讓他押哪個做法？
en/ae_mei/91a6adb1.heard: Two people is enough for a hunch. The client has to settle on a launch tonight. Which idea are you asking them to back?

en/client_chen/92357013.text: When the pandemic hit, my boss cut the studio budget. He wants that money spent on traffic, but he still wants to see a new cut at noon.
en/client_chen/92357013.zh: 疫情一來，老闆把棚費砍了。他要我把錢挪去買流量，但中午還是要看到新片。
en/client_chen/92357013.heard: When the pandemic hit, my boss cut the studio budget. He wants that money spent on traffic, but he still wants to see a new cut at noon.

ae_mei/48c0634d.text: 店長剛傳訊息，芋圓賣完了，助理還在推。明早的入口我得先跟客戶定下來。
ae_mei/48c0634d.heard: 店長剛傳訊息，芋圓賣完了，助理還在推，明早的入扣我得先跟客戶定下來。

en/ae_mei/498c1d0d.text: The studio shoot's gone, too. They need a cut by noon or they'll run last year's.
en/ae_mei/498c1d0d.zh: 棚拍也砍了。中午前要一版，不然就上去年的。
en/ae_mei/498c1d0d.heard: The studio shoot's gone too. They need a cut by noon, or they'll run last year's.

en/cd_wei/ca799dcd.text: Okay. We're out of here at four. Tell the camera crew what you want to shoot next.
en/cd_wei/ca799dcd.zh: 好，棚四點要還。妳跟攝影說，下一顆拍什麼？
en/cd_wei/ca799dcd.heard: Okay, we're out of here at four. Tell the camera crew what you want to shoot next.

en/player_f/65da8d8f.text: She drew the room she wants. I want to hold on her dad for a beat while he unfolds it.
en/player_f/65da8d8f.zh: 畫上是她想要的房間。我想留她爸把畫攤開的那一拍。
en/player_f/65da8d8f.heard: She drew the room she wants. I want to hold on her dad for a beat while he unfolds it.

en/player_f/39612ab6.text: A shopper just picked up the refill, then put the original bottle back. She wasn't sure the two would fit.
en/player_f/39612ab6.zh: 剛剛有個客人拿起補充包看，還把原本那瓶擺回去，怕兩個接不起來。
en/player_f/39612ab6.heard: A shopper just picked up the refill, then put the original bottle back. She wasn't sure the two would fit

en/player_f/a9ce634d.text: Wei, look at this take. The kid slips her drawing under the door and her dad crouches to pick it up.
en/player_f/a9ce634d.zh: 威哥，你看這段試拍。小孩剛把畫塞進門縫，她爸就蹲下來接。
en/player_f/a9ce634d.heard: Wait, look at this take. The kid slips her drawing under the door, and her dad crouches to pick it up.

en/cd_wei/9647807e.text: Half a day left in the studio. Pull the fake grass off the set. Keep the sink.
en/cd_wei/9647807e.zh: 棚只剩半天。妳先把那片假草皮撤掉，水槽留著。
en/cd_wei/9647807e.heard: Half a day left in the studio. Pull the fake grass off the set, keep the sink.

en/boss_lin/08720543.text: The client's inside. Page nine gets one media schedule. You make the call.
en/boss_lin/08720543.zh: 客戶在裡面。第九頁留一張排期表，你決定買哪一檔。
en/boss_lin/08720543.heard: The client's inside. Page nine gets one media schedule. You make the call.

en/data_kai/c31a4818.text: Sure. Chen still needs one slide for noon that tells his boss how we'll judge whether the ad worked.
en/data_kai/c31a4818.zh: 可以啊。只是中午那張投影片，陳經理還得跟老闆交代這支片要拿什麼驗收。
en/data_kai/c31a4818.heard: Sure. Chen still needs one slide for noon that tells his boss how we'll judge whether the ad worked.

en/player_f/f56f0f61.text: We can shoot that. Phone right up by the counter, hands and the empty bottle in frame, clerk answering through a mask. Saves us the rental, too.
en/player_f/f56f0f61.zh: 這句可以拍。用手機貼著櫃檯拍手跟空罐，店員隔著口罩回她，連場租都省了。
en/player_f/f56f0f61.heard: We can shoot that. Phone right up by the counter, hands and the empty bottle in frame, clerk answering through a mask. Saves us the rental, too.

en/data_kai/00ae6816.text: The chatbot placement reports clicks. We can give each placement its own coupon code and I'll match those to in-store redemptions.
en/data_kai/00ae6816.zh: 對話版位有點擊數。店裡的新品券可以分版位編碼，我來對核銷。
en/data_kai/00ae6816.heard: Okay, so the chatbot placement reports clicks. We can give each placement its own coupon code, and I'll match those to in-store redemptions.

en/data_kai/50730a0b.text: I played the rough cut on my phone here in the data lab. Two seconds of a time clock, and the client asked if we were hiring.
en/data_kai/50730a0b.zh: 我在數據實驗室用手機播了粗剪。前兩秒只有打卡鐘，客戶問這是不是在徵人。
en/data_kai/50730a0b.heard: I played the rough cut on my phone here in the Dada lab, 2 seconds of a time clock, and the client asked if we were hiring.

en/player_f/63c6d4e6.text: Wait for the click. The time card pops out, then the straw punches through the cup seal. I want you to hear it and know the shift is over.
en/player_f/63c6d4e6.zh: 等那聲喀噠。打卡紙一吐出來，就接吸管戳破封膜，我想讓人一聽就知道下班了。
en/player_f/63c6d4e6.heard: Wait for the click. The time card pops out, then the straw punches through the cup seal. I want you to hear it and know the shift is over.

en/player_f/09289116.text: I’ll shoot a close-up with the real cup on the desk first. Once I cut those two shots together, the client can see what I’m going for.
en/player_f/09289116.zh: 那我先用桌上的真杯拍一顆特寫。把兩個畫面接起來，至少能讓客戶看到我在想什麼。
en/player_f/09289116.heard: I'll shoot a close-up with the real cup on the desk first. Once I cut those two shots together, the client can see what I'm going for.

en/player_f/66339ecc.text: All right, I'll sketch the opening. What do we want her to see before she scrolls past?
en/player_f/66339ecc.zh: 好，我先畫開場。觀眾滑走以前，我們到底要讓她看到什麼？
en/player_f/66339ecc.heard: All right, I'll sketch the opening. What do we want her to see before she scrolls past?

en/cd_wei/896f09b8.text: I like that shot. The client circled it and wrote 'cut.' Says they can't tell who we're helping find a home.
en/cd_wei/896f09b8.zh: 這顆我喜歡。客戶剛圈起來說要剪掉，說看不出我們在幫誰找房子。
en/cd_wei/896f09b8.heard: I like that shot. The client circled it and wrote cut. Says they can't tell who we're helping find a home.

en/client_hsu/9fd590a8.text: My boss wants "Better for the planet" in bigger print. You handle strategy. Do you think that line can turn sales around?
en/client_hsu/9fd590a8.zh: 主管要我把「友善地球」印大一點。你是策略企劃，先幫我看看這句能不能救銷量。
en/client_hsu/9fd590a8.heard: My boss wants better for the planet in bigger print. You handle strategy. Do you think that line can turn sales around?

en/cd_wei/662bb5dd.text: We lost the location. Art built us this door. Pan an inch to the right and you'll see the set ends.
en/cd_wei/662bb5dd.zh: 外景取消了。美術搭的就這扇門，攝影機往右一點就會穿幫。
en/cd_wei/662bb5dd.heard: We lost the location. Art built us this door, pan an inch to the right and you'll see the set ends.

en/client_chen/4173db69.text: Last year's orders and the stores' customer inquiries are at Lanshan Plaza. Can you take a look? I need to know if that scene is worth filming.
en/client_chen/4173db69.zh: 去年訂單跟門市的詢問紀錄都在藍山廣場。妳先去看一下，我得知道這一幕值不值得拍。
en/client_chen/4173db69.heard: Last year's orders and the store's customer inquiries are at Lanshan Plaza. Can you take a look? I need to know if that scene is worth filming.

en/player_f/b47c8ee4.text: I wanted to cut that hanger too. Which shot did the client keep?
en/player_f/b47c8ee4.zh: 那個衣架我也想砍。客戶留了哪一顆鏡頭？
en/player_f/b47c8ee4.heard: I wanted to cut that hanger too. Which shot did the client keep?

en/temple_uncle/bc6c82f3.text: Miss, could you move that tripod? The fabric shop owner needs to get his cart through.
en/temple_uncle/bc6c82f3.zh: 小姐，腳架挪一下，布莊老闆等一下要推布車過去。
en/temple_uncle/bc6c82f3.heard: Ooh, miss. Could you move that tripod? The fabric shop owner needs to get his cart through.

en/client_hsu/89a46454.text: That's why I wanted a shot that actually shows the pour. But my boss wants the price in the first three seconds.
en/client_hsu/89a46454.zh: 所以我才想補一個倒給她看的鏡頭。可是老闆說，前三秒一定要有價格。
en/client_hsu/89a46454.heard: That's why I wanted a shot that actually shows the pour, but my boss wants the price in the first three seconds.

en/player_f/a7f2007e.text: I'll take my phone down to the Earth God shrine on Fude Street. Wei, can you grab the storyboard?
en/player_f/a7f2007e.zh: 我先拿手機走一趟福德街土地公廟。威哥，你幫我拿一下分鏡板。
en/player_f/a7f2007e.heard: Ah, I'll take my phone down to the Earth God Shrine on Fudo Street. Wait, can you grab the storyboard?

en/client_hsu/e2a573d7.text: I'm holding this cut. Eight seconds of floating leaves and I still don't know how to use the pouch.
en/client_hsu/e2a573d7.zh: 這支我先卡一下。葉子飄了八秒，我還不知道那包要怎麼用。
en/client_hsu/e2a573d7.heard: I'm holding this cut. Eight seconds of floating leaves and I still don't know how to use the pouch.

en/client_hsu/f6577616.text: One more thing. I can't sign off on 'zero impact on the planet.' That part needs a recut.
en/client_hsu/f6577616.zh: 還有，那句「對地球零負擔」我沒辦法簽，這段要重剪。
en/client_hsu/f6577616.heard: One more thing. I can't sign off on zero impact on the planet. That part needs a recut.

en/data_kai/3e7c1bad.text: Okay, I’ll set up the phone. We need a vertical cut by eight tomorrow morning. How do you want to edit it?
en/data_kai/3e7c1bad.zh: 好，我把手機架好。明早八點前要交直式檔，妳打算怎麼剪？
en/data_kai/3e7c1bad.heard: Okay, I'll set up the phone. We need a vertical cut by 8:00 tomorrow morning. How do you want to edit it?

en/ae_mei/bc534a64.text: Just the store name at the end. They want it vertical, and we've got half a day to shoot.
en/ae_mei/bc534a64.zh: 只留片尾的店名。他們要直式，預算只夠拍半天。
en/ae_mei/bc534a64.heard: Just the store name at the end. They want it vertical, and we've got half a day to shoot.

en/ae_mei/ff54e896.text: The client wants the cup and the promo code right up front. We can move money out of print, but we only get an hour in the shop after closing.
en/ae_mei/ff54e896.zh: 客戶要一開場就看到杯子跟優惠碼。印素材的費用可以挪，拍攝只能借門市打烊後一小時。
en/ae_mei/ff54e896.heard: The client wants the cup and the promo code right up front. We can move money out of print, but we only get an hour in the shop after closing.

en/cd_wei/2d65a889.text: That cup in the storyboard has milk foam the shop doesn’t serve. I’ll get you a time clock. We’ll have to reshoot the cup.
en/cd_wei/2d65a889.zh: 分鏡裡那杯有店裡沒有的奶蓋。我先幫妳借打卡鐘，杯子得重拍。
en/cd_wei/2d65a889.heard: That cup in the storyboard has milk foam the shop doesn't serve. I'll get you a time clock. We'll have to reshoot the cup.

en/player_f/1cad054a.text: I want to open on his hand. Then we cut to someone taking the jacket at the next shop's door.
en/player_f/1cad054a.zh: 我想從他那隻手開場，下一顆讓外套從隔壁店門口接進來。
en/player_f/1cad054a.heard: I want to open on his hand, then we cut to someone taking the jacket at the next shop's door.

en/temple_uncle/f93cc864.text: Go ahead. Show him what you shoot, though. He's worried people will only remember the flagship.
en/temple_uncle/f93cc864.zh: 可以問啊。記得先給他看你拍到什麼，他很怕大家看完只記得旗艦店。
en/temple_uncle/f93cc864.heard: Go ahead. Show him what you shoot, though. He's worried people will only remember the flagship.

en/tv_su/5a533623.text: He wants the soy sauce bottle in the first second. He even asked if we could slap the discount on the label.
en/tv_su/5a533623.zh: 他要第一秒就看到醬油瓶，還問能不能把折扣貼在瓶身上。
en/tv_su/5a533623.heard: He wants the soy sauce bottle in the first second. He even asked if we could slap the discount on the label.

en/player_f/735355ca.text: That chair's for the daughter getting off work late. When she sits, you finally get why there's an extra bowl of rice.
en/player_f/735355ca.zh: 那張椅子是留給晚下班的人。她一坐下，觀眾才懂桌上為什麼多一碗飯。
en/player_f/735355ca.heard: That chair is for the daughter getting off work late. When she sits, you finally get why there's an extra bowl of rice.

en/breakfast_auntie/b2adb31c.text: I muted the TV so I could hear the orders. Hey, leave that chair there for now.
en/breakfast_auntie/b2adb31c.zh: 電視先靜音喔，點餐都聽不見。欸，旁邊那張椅子先別收。
en/breakfast_auntie/b2adb31c.heard: I muted the TV so I could hear the orders. Hey, leave that chair there for now.

en/cd_wei/5249843e.text: The AI mock-up? By the third glowing hanger, I was ready to swipe.
en/cd_wei/5249843e.zh: 就是那支用 AI 做預演的？我看到第三個發亮的衣架就想滑掉。
en/cd_wei/5249843e.heard: The AI mockup? By the third glowing hanger, I was ready to swipe.

en/player_f/a3f768ce.text: Wait, he just handed the jacket, hanger and all, to the guy next door to try on. Mind if I ask him to do it again?
en/player_f/a3f768ce.zh: 等一下，他把那件外套連衣架遞給隔壁試穿耶。我可以問他願不願意再做一次嗎？
en/player_f/a3f768ce.heard: Wait, he just handed the jacket, hanger and all, to the guy next door to try on. Mind if I ask him to do it again?

en/breakfast_auntie/390a7c37.text: Sure. Eat up first, though. Once that egg pancake goes cold, I can't give you another take.
en/breakfast_auntie/390a7c37.zh: 可以啊。你先吃，蛋餅冷了我可沒辦法重拍。
en/breakfast_auntie/390a7c37.heard: Sure. Eat up first, though. Once that egg pancake goes cold, I can't give you another take.

en/cd_wei/1d4036bd.text: That could work. In half a day, we'll need the shops to stick to our schedule. And the client still wants to know if the price can go in the first second.
en/cd_wei/1d4036bd.zh: 這樣有戲。但半天要拍完，店家得配合時間。客戶還在問價錢能不能第一秒就出來。
en/cd_wei/1d4036bd.heard: That could work. In half a day, we'll need the shops to stick to our schedule, and the client still wants to know if the price can go in the first second.

en/tv_su/f8aed618.text: Go see Auntie Xiuqin on the corner. She usually mutes the TV. See what you can still follow with the sound off.
en/tv_su/f8aed618.zh: 去巷口找秀琴姨。她店裡那台電視常靜音，你看看只剩畫面時，什麼還看得懂。
en/tv_su/f8aed618.heard: Go see Auntie Xiaoqing on the corner. She usually mutes the TV. See what you can still follow with the sound off.

en/player_f/8ac63dbf.text: Those unwrapped chopsticks tell you someone's waiting for her. I want that in the shot.
en/player_f/8ac63dbf.zh: 原來筷子先拆開，就知道有人在等。我想把這個拍進去。
en/player_f/8ac63dbf.heard: Those unwrapped chopsticks tell you someone's waiting for her. I want that in the shot.

en/cd_wei/40d85689.text: Camera crew's in at seven tomorrow. We've got the table and lights for one day. You need to call the shots tonight.
en/cd_wei/40d85689.zh: 攝影明早七點到。桌子跟燈只租一天，你今晚得決定怎麼拍。
en/cd_wei/40d85689.heard: Camera crew's in at seven tomorrow. We've got the table and lights for one day. You need to call the shots tonight.

en/client_wu/12f0837f.text: Our stores were also handing out coupons at the register. How do I tell what brought people in?
en/client_wu/12f0837f.zh: 門市還在收銀台發折價券。那我怎麼知道客人是被哪邊拉進來的？
en/client_wu/12f0837f.heard: Our stores were also handing out coupons at the register. How do I tell what brought people in?

en/breakfast_auntie/222dcb34.text: Yeah, her daughter's just finishing her shift across the street. Look, she's even unwrapped the chopsticks for her.
en/breakfast_auntie/222dcb34.zh: 有啊，她女兒在對面交班。你看，她連免洗筷都幫人家拆好了。
en/breakfast_auntie/222dcb34.heard: Yeah, her daughter's just finishing her shift across the street. Look, she's even unwrapped the chopsticks for her.

en/ae_mei/0654de34.text: They cut the location shoot. Tonight's promo code is still on. Marketing wants orders from the opening shot, and the product team wants final approval.
en/ae_mei/0654de34.zh: 他們砍了外景，說今晚的折扣碼照上。行銷要開頭就帶人下單，商品部要先看成片。
en/ae_mei/0654de34.heard: They cut the location shoot. Tonight's promo code is still on. Marketing wants orders from the opening shot, and the product team wants final approval.

en/boss_lin/d5459c68.text: They're waiting in the conference room. You're the creative. Which cut goes on slide nine? Tell me what can go straight out and what needs a sign-off.
en/boss_lin/d5459c68.zh: 會議室在等。妳是創意，第九頁放哪支？也說清楚哪些剪完就能送，哪些得有人點頭。
en/boss_lin/d5459c68.heard: They're waiting in the conference room. You're the creative. Which cut goes on slide nine? Tell me what can go straight out and, uh, what needs a sign-off.

en/player_m/706709c9.text: This column counts exits across the whole station. That whole crowd just took the turn toward the bus terminal without passing this wall.
en/player_m/706709c9.zh: 這欄是整站的出站人次。剛剛一整排人往轉運站走，根本沒經過這面牆。
en/player_m/706709c9.heard: This column counts exits across the whole station, that whole crowd just took the turn toward the bus terminal without passing this wall.

en/boss_lin/eca464ba.text: Buy First Select just pulled the ad. They put ours next to the rival's. Both open with someone crossing the street in the rain.
en/boss_lin/eca464ba.zh: 買了再說選物剛喊卡。客戶把我們的片跟競品並排，兩支開頭都是人走過下雨的斑馬線。
en/boss_lin/eca464ba.heard: But First Select just pulled the ad. They put ours next to the rivals'. Both opened with someone crossing the street in the rain.

en/client_wu/f8764629.text: Look, more people came out of the station on the trial day, and hot Americanos sold well. My boss says we should book this wall.
en/client_wu/f8764629.zh: 你看，試賣那天出站的人多，熱美式也賣得好。老闆說，買這面就對了。
en/client_wu/f8764629.heard: Look, more people came out of the station on the trial day, and hot Americanos sold well. My boss says we should book this wall.

en/player_m/c325032c.text: And that sale never shows up in the search report. Let me mark those three days as out of stock.
en/player_m/c325032c.zh: 那他的這一筆，搜尋報告找不到。我先把缺貨那三天圈起來。
en/player_m/c325032c.heard: and that sale never shows up in the search report. Let me mark those three days as out of stock.

en/player_m/19a1b3e0.text: I'll take out the refunds. If we're looking for extra sales from the ad, I'd like some time slots without it to compare against.
en/player_m/19a1b3e0.zh: 我會把退款扣掉。看板要算帶來幾杯，最好還有一段沒播廣告的時段可以比。
en/player_m/19a1b3e0.heard: I'll take out the refunds. If we're looking for extra sales from the ad, I'd like some time slots without it to compare against.

en/clerk_ning/4138fc3b.text: Hang on. We sold out Tuesday, and the next shipment came Saturday. Look, the date's right under the barcode.
en/clerk_ning/4138fc3b.zh: 有啊，週二就賣光了，週六才補到。你看，日期印在條碼下面。
en/clerk_ning/4138fc3b.heard: Hang on, we sold out Tuesday and the next shipment came Saturday. Look, the date's right under the barcode.

en/player_f/45beb9f3.text: The real one's black. I shot a try-on on Wuxing Street today. A woman clips the strap and frees up a hand to grab her breakfast.
en/player_f/45beb9f3.zh: 實品是黑的。我今天在吳興街拍到一段試背，女生扣好背帶，騰出手去接早餐。
en/player_f/45beb9f3.heard: The real one's black. I shot a try-on on Wuxing Street today. A woman clips the strap and frees up a hand to grab her breakfast.

en/boss_lin/0ff337ed.text: Try the corner store on Songshou Road. While you're there, ask who's been buying lately.
en/boss_lin/0ff337ed.zh: 去松壽路巷口那間。順便問店員最近是誰在買。
en/boss_lin/0ff337ed.heard: Try the corner store on Songso Road. While you're there, ask who's been buying lately.

en/player_m/3ee3beee.text: You’ve circled 0317 on both pages. Can I get the full order numbers? I want to see if it’s the same purchase.
en/player_m/3ee3beee.zh: 這兩張都圈了末四碼 0317。能給我完整單號嗎？我想查是不是同一筆。
en/player_m/3ee3beee.heard: You've circled 0317 on both pages. Can I get the full order numbers? I want to see if it's the same purchase.

en/player_m/681b16a0.text: I'm checking sales for Itch Be Gone. Do you have last Friday's delivery slip?
en/player_m/681b16a0.zh: 我在對腳癢退散的銷量。你有上週五那張進貨單嗎？
en/player_m/681b16a0.heard: I'm checking sales for Itch-B-Gone. Do you have last Friday's delivery slip?

en/boss_lin/0b6e683c.text: Ask at the store on Songshou Road. Get back to me by eleven thirty. HQ's waiting to release the budget.
en/boss_lin/0b6e683c.zh: 去松壽路那家問。十一點半前回我，總公司等著放預算。
en/boss_lin/0b6e683c.heard: Ask at the store on Songso Road. Get back to me by 11:30. HQ's waiting to release the budget.

en/player_m/5127e922.text: I've got the store's sales, but it shows zero from Wednesday through Friday last week. I want to see the delivery records for those days.
en/player_m/5127e922.zh: 我這裡有超商銷量，但上週三到週五都是零。我想看一下那三天的補貨單。
en/player_m/5127e922.heard: I've got the store's sales, but it shows zero from Wednesday through Friday last week. I want to see the delivery records for those days.

en/player_m/9ceca37f.text: That explains three days without a single sale. Who was buying on Tuesday?
en/player_m/9ceca37f.zh: 難怪連三天刷不出一筆。週二來買的是誰啊？
en/player_m/9ceca37f.heard: That explains three days without a single sale. Who was buying on Tuesday?

en/client_wu/4080af81.text: We've got a month's budget. I have to head back to the office soon. Pick an approach and tell me what I can take to my boss at the end of the month.
en/client_wu/4080af81.zh: 預算就一個月。等等我得回公司，你先挑一種做法，告訴我月底能拿什麼去見老闆。
en/client_wu/4080af81.heard: We've got a month's budget. I have to head back to the office soon. Pick an approach and tell me what I can take to my boss at the end of the month.

en/clerk_ning/31c23e42.text: One older guy was out making deliveries on his scooter. His raincoat was still dripping. He asked for the same tube as last time. Even remembered the color of the box.
en/clerk_ning/31c23e42.zh: 有個騎車送貨的阿伯，雨衣還滴水。他直接問我有沒有上次那條，包裝的顏色都記得。
en/clerk_ning/31c23e42.heard: One older guy was out making deliveries on his scooter his raincoat was still dripping he asked for the same tube as last time even remembered the color of the box

en/data_kai/1f1e4cc6.text: Full order number matches for 0317. The customer clicked an ad, then opened LINE for a coupon before checking out.

en/data_kai/1f1e4cc6.heard: Full order number matches 40317. The customer clicked an ad, then opened Line for a coupon before checking out.

en/data_kai/ceb7ffc5.text: I pulled the raw export. That green line counts form opens. If I open it three times, that’s three hits.
en/data_kai/ceb7ffc5.zh: 我把後台匯出來了。綠線算的是開表單，同一個人開三次也算三筆。
en/data_kai/ceb7ffc5.heard: I pulled the raw export. That green line counts form opens. If I open it three times, that's three hits.

en/player_m/b9df1c64.text: Hang on. Let’s test one thing first. If we run both again, we’ll still be guessing.

en/player_m/b9df1c64.heard: Hang on. Let's test one thing first. If we run both again, we'll still be guessing.

en/client_hsu/1975cf14.text: Right, we did both on Saturday. My boss saw the numbers and asked me to print another batch of coupons for next week.

en/client_hsu/1975cf14.heard: Right. We did both on Saturday. My boss saw the numbers and asked me to print another batch of coupons for next week.

en/data_kai/f8dc27ae.text: I checked the register logs. Returns have their own transaction code, and this report only pulls sales.

en/data_kai/f8dc27ae.heard: Hey, I checked the register logs. Returns have their own transaction code, and this report only pulls sales.

en/data_kai/89639622.text: I ran both cuts through a simulated audience. It helped pick an opener. We'll need real viewers to see if they'd buy.

en/data_kai/89639622.heard: I ran both cuts through a simulated audience. It helped pick an opener. What, we need real viewers to see if they'd buy.

en/ae_mei/46dff473.text: The client’s here at four to pick up the cut. What do I put on the slide in place of “The ad drove bookings”?

en/ae_mei/46dff473.heard: The client's here at 4:00 to pick up the cut. What do I put on the slide in place of the ad drove bookings?

en/player_m/aca6c820.text: I took out the returns. Saturday still comes out on top. That’s when we sent out coupons and had someone at the counter showing people how to pour the refills.
en/player_m/aca6c820.zh: 我把退貨扣回去了，最高的還是週六。那天有發券，櫃上也有人教客人怎麼倒。
en/player_m/aca6c820.heard: I took out the returns. Saturday still comes out on top. That's when we sent out coupons and had someone at the counter showing people how to pour the refills.

en/tv_su/09c70b42.text: The client crossed out the shot where she pulls out the chair. He's worried people will scroll past if the first three seconds feel empty.
en/tv_su/09c70b42.zh: 客戶把拉椅子那格劃掉了。片頭空三秒，他怕觀眾直接滑走。
en/tv_su/09c70b42.heard: The client crossed out the shot where she pulls out the chair. He's worried people will scroll past if the first three seconds feel empty.

en/client_hsu/71f4a22a.text: Okay, the counter staff can help with one round. At Friday’s meeting, I need you to tell me if this is worth paying for.
en/client_hsu/71f4a22a.zh: 好，櫃上可以配合一次。週五開會，你得告訴我這筆錢值不值得花。
en/client_hsu/71f4a22a.heard: Okay, the counter staff can help with one round. At Friday's meeting, I need you to tell me if this is worth paying for.

en/ae_mei/dc839bfe.text: They want that slide tonight. Can you check what they're counting as a visitor?

en/ae_mei/dc839bfe.heard: they want that slide tonight. Can you check what they're counting as a visitor?

en/player_m/350f14d1.text: The shrine sticker's on the back of a red chair. I just scanned it on the same phone. Did it show up?

en/data_kai/05d6749b.heard: Hey, take a look. No Overtime Milk Tea tried AI ordering, and the dashboard says orders are up 30%.

en/player_m/1271ca59.heard: Got time stamps? I want to line them up with the station's airing logs.
