en/player_f/4b1e9af4.heard: I tried it on my phone. Checkout kicks me back to the login screen before the cart even shows shipping.

en/player_f/04c61cf5.text: I scanned one just like it at City Hall Bus Terminal. My phone made me sign up first. I almost closed the page when it asked for a verification code.
en/player_f/04c61cf5.zh: 我剛在市府轉運站掃同款杯套。手機要我先註冊，我差點在驗證碼那步就關掉。
en/player_f/04c61cf5.heard: I scanned one just like it at City Hall bus terminal. My phone made me sign up first. I almost closed the page when it asked for a verification code.

en/ae_mei/e8b471d2.text: The client told me this afternoon they need orders to show Finance at month-end. They still want that MRT placement, too.
en/ae_mei/e8b471d2.zh: 客戶下午才說，月底要拿訂單去跟財務交代。那張捷運圖他也想留。
en/ae_mei/e8b471d2.heard: The client told me this afternoon they need orders to show finance at month-end. They still want that MRT placement, too.

en/client_wu/cd05f2ff.text: One of our regulars got all the way through payment. The cashier told her online orders don't earn points, so she lined up again to ask how to get hers credited.
en/client_wu/cd05f2ff.zh: 有個常客撐到付完錢。店員說網路單不能集點，她只好再排隊問怎麼補。
en/client_wu/cd05f2ff.heard: One of our regulars got all the way through payment. The cashier told her online orders don't earn points, so she lined up again to ask how to get hers credited.

en/player_f/69c95398.text: Mind if I borrow this sleeve, Manager Wu? I want the first slide tonight to show what she went through, from scanning it to having to chase support.
en/player_f/69c95398.zh: 吳經理，這張杯套我借一下。今晚提案第一頁，我想放她從掃碼到回頭問客服的路。
en/player_f/69c95398.heard: Mind if I borrow this sleeve, Manager Wu? I want the first slide tonight to show what she went through, from scanning it to having to chase support.

en/breakfast_auntie/cdb5a257.text: Go ahead and snap a photo of the invoice. Pass me the soy sauce, would you? That egg pancake's about to burn.
en/breakfast_auntie/cdb5a257.zh: 你先把進貨單拍一拍，醬油罐借我一下，鐵板上那份蛋餅快焦了。
en/breakfast_auntie/cdb5a257.heard: Oh, go ahead and snap a photo of the invoice. Pass me the soy sauce, would you? That egg pancake's about to burn.

en/player_f/86cb46fa.text: Is this where she bought it the first time, too?
en/player_f/86cb46fa.zh: 她第一次買也是來這裡嗎？
en/player_f/86cb46fa.heard: Is this where she bought it the first time too?

en/ae_mei/119a4406.text: Support just dropped a screenshot in LINE. The customer’s still asking how to return the item, and the dashboard says it’s resolved.
en/ae_mei/119a4406.zh: 客服剛在 LINE 丟了一張截圖。那位客人還在問怎麼退，儀表板卻說已解決。
en/ae_mei/119a4406.heard: Support just dropped a screenshot inline. The customer's still asking how to return the item and the dashboard says it's resolved.

en/boss_lin/f88562d0.text: Okay. By noon, I need one thing we can do. I’ll take it to HQ.
en/boss_lin/f88562d0.zh: 好。中午前給我一個做法，我去跟總公司談。
en/boss_lin/f88562d0.heard: Okay. By noon, I need one thing we can do. I'll take it to HQ.

en/ae_mei/17b50e63.text: A customer called yesterday. She tapped through from a Story, but at checkout the login code never came through.
en/ae_mei/17b50e63.zh: 昨天有個客人打來，她從限動點進去，結帳時卻收不到會員驗證簡訊。
en/ae_mei/17b50e63.heard: A customer called yesterday. She tapped through from a story, but at checkout, the login code never came through.

en/clerk_ning/b1b4c9c2.text: A lady came in with an empty box this morning. She said the website kept asking her to log in, so she just came downstairs to buy it.
en/clerk_ning/b1b4c9c2.zh: 早上有位阿姨拿著空盒來。她說官網一直叫她登入，乾脆下樓買。
en/clerk_ning/b1b4c9c2.heard: A lady came in with an empty box this morning. She said the website kept asking her to log in, so she just came downstairs to buy it.

en/player_f/4d535afa.text: She actually came back for it. Can we pull what she bought in store into her online account?
en/player_f/4d535afa.zh: 她特地回來一趟耶。門市那筆買過的款式，有辦法接到官網嗎？
en/player_f/4d535afa.heard: She actually came back for it. Can we pull what she bought in store into her online account?

en/clerk_ning/f50119ec.text: When we’re out, all I can do is send her to another store and hope for the best. Could your site help her ask who has it in stock first?
en/clerk_ning/f50119ec.zh: 缺貨時我只能請她去別間碰運氣。你們官網能讓她先問哪裡有貨嗎？
en/clerk_ning/f50119ec.heard: When we're out, all I can do is send her to another store and hope for the best. Could your site help her ask who has it in stock first?

en/player_f/418cff7f.text: If she comes all this way for nothing, she still has to dig out her password when she gets home. No wonder that ticket’s still open.
en/player_f/418cff7f.zh: 她如果白跑一趟，回去還得重找密碼。難怪客服那張單還開著。
en/player_f/418cff7f.heard: If she comes all this way for nothing, she still has to dig out her password when she gets home, no wonder that ticket's still open.

en/boss_lin/d90bfce2.text: You’re the data analyst. Take a look at this chart. Buy First Select says case closures shot up as soon as the agent went live.
en/boss_lin/d90bfce2.zh: 你是數據分析師，幫我看一下這張圖。買了再說選物說，Agent 一上線，結案數就往上跳。
en/boss_lin/d90bfce2.heard: You're the data analyst. Take a look at this chart. VP of CX says case closures shot up as soon as the agent went live.

en/player_f/c177a427.text: Her support ticket says she bought it last time at the convenience store on Songshou Road. I’ll ask the clerk how regulars restock.
en/player_f/c177a427.zh: 客服那張單還寫著，她上次是在松壽路的超商買的。我去問店員熟客怎麼補貨。
en/player_f/c177a427.heard: Her support ticket says she bought it last time at the convenience store on Songshou Road. I'll ask the clerk how regulars restock.

en/data_kai/e0a54599.text: We can start by verifying the phone number on her membership. The stores have to change their process too, or support will still be asking for bottle photos next week.
en/data_kai/e0a54599.zh: 可以先用會員手機驗證。門市那邊得一起改，不然客服下週還是要請人拍瓶底。
en/data_kai/e0a54599.heard: We can start by verifying the phone number on her membership. The stores have to change their process too, or support will still be asking for bottle photos next week.

en/clerk_ning/ecc4020d.text: Yep. Her shoes got soaked in the rain and she needed it right away. Now she comes straight in and asks if we have any.
en/clerk_ning/ecc4020d.zh: 對，雨天鞋子濕了，趕著用。她現在來都直接問還有沒有。
en/clerk_ning/ecc4020d.heard: Yep, her shoes got soaked in the rain and she needed it right away. Now she comes straight in and asks if we have any.

en/client_chen/566452d1.text: My boss just wants to know how many orders we lost this week. The order files are at Lanshan Plaza Data Lab. Can you take a look?
en/client_chen/566452d1.zh: 老闆只問這週少了幾張單。藍山廣場的數據實驗室有訂單檔，能不能先幫我看看？
en/client_chen/566452d1.heard: My boss just wants to know how many orders we lost this week. The order files are at Lanshan Plaza data lab. Can you take a look?

en/player_f/4ea77268.text: Let me try it on my phone. I can see the shipping fee, but the second I hit checkout, it makes me sign up.
en/player_f/4ea77268.zh: 我用手機走一次。都看到運費了，按下結帳才跳出要我註冊。
en/player_f/4ea77268.heard: Oh, let me try it on my phone. I can see the shipping fee, but the second I hit checkout, it makes me sign up.

en/player_m/dbbfe99f.text: I'll ask her when she picked the brand. Kai, leave that order out of the rollup for now.
en/player_m/dbbfe99f.zh: 我去問她是什麼時候決定買的。阿凱，訂單先別併總表。
en/player_m/dbbfe99f.heard: I'll ask her when she picked the brand. Chai, leave that order out of the roll-up for now.

en/cd_wei/c8b9ed66.text: Everyone in the test stream was asking about the clam soup. The client says the carts just sat there once we went off air last night.
en/cd_wei/c8b9ed66.zh: 試播留言都在問那包蛤蜊湯，客戶卻說昨晚直播一關，購物車就沒動了。
en/cd_wei/c8b9ed66.heard: Everyone in the test stream was asking about the clam soup. The client says the carts just sat there once we went off air last night.

en/ae_mei/7dc4a78f.text: Support printed out last night's chats for me. One regular asked three times if they could change the delivery date, then said they'd order some other time.
en/ae_mei/7dc4a78f.zh: 客服把昨晚的對話印給我了。有位熟客問了三次能不能改到貨日，最後說下次再買。
en/ae_mei/7dc4a78f.heard: Support printed out last night's chats for me. One regular asked three times if they could change the delivery date, then said they'd order some other time.

en/client_hsu/faeddfcb.text: Look at this screenshot. A shopper tapped through from the unboxing clip, added a refill, and still had to ask support.
en/client_hsu/faeddfcb.zh: 你看這張截圖，客人從開箱短片點進來，補充包都放進購物車了，最後還是跑來問客服。
en/client_hsu/faeddfcb.heard: Look at this screenshot. A shopper tapped through from the unboxing clip, added a refill, and still had to ask support

en/boss_lin/682fa220.text: Seen the Itch Be Gone report? Searches are down, so HQ wants to send members a coupon at noon to lift sales.
en/boss_lin/682fa220.zh: 腳癢退散那份報告看了嗎？搜尋量掉了，總公司中午想發會員券救業績。
en/boss_lin/682fa220.heard: Seen the Itch-Be-Gone report? Searches are down, so HQ wants to send members a coupon at noon to lift sales.

en/data_kai/23e07fe1.text: Found it. She hit checkout twice that afternoon, then came back through the product page the next day. The refill was still in her cart. No order.
en/data_kai/23e07fe1.zh: 對到了。那天下午她點了兩次結帳，隔天又從商品頁進來，購物車還在，訂單是空的。
en/data_kai/23e07fe1.heard: Found it. She hit checkout twice that afternoon, then came back through the product page the next day. The refill was still in her cart. No order.

en/player_f/ef67ed9d.text: Wei, I tried it on my phone. You have to sign up before you can see shipping, and if you forget your password, you have to leave to check your email.
en/player_f/ef67ed9d.zh: 威哥，我用手機走了一遍。看到運費前要先註冊，忘記密碼還得跳出去收信。
en/player_f/ef67ed9d.heard: Wait, I tried it on my phone. You have to sign up before you can see shipping. And if you forget your password, you have to leave to check your email.

en/data_kai/1688693e.text: The member login is where we lost the most people last night. The logs can't tell me if it was the hassle or the cost of frozen shipping.
en/data_kai/1688693e.zh: 昨晚最多人停在會員登入那頁。光看紀錄，我還分不出是嫌麻煩，還是怕冷凍運費太貴。
en/data_kai/1688693e.heard: The member login is where we lost the most people last night. The logs can't tell me if it was a hassle or the cost of frozen shipping,

en/cd_wei/fcfd5bd7.text: We’ll shoot the spot as planned. You tell me what goes on the end card and what goes on tonight’s slide.
en/cd_wei/fcfd5bd7.zh: 正片照拍。片尾怎麼留、今晚那頁放什麼，你幫我定。
en/cd_wei/fcfd5bd7.heard: We'll shoot the spot as planned. You tell me what goes on the end card and what goes on tonight's slide.

en/player_f/c52a0a89.text: I've put the stream link, the checkout screens, and the support tickets side by side. The launch is tonight, and the people who buy might come back for more next week.
en/player_f/c52a0a89.zh: 我把直播連結、結帳畫面跟客服單貼在一起了。今晚首播，買過的人下週還可能來補貨。
en/player_f/c52a0a89.heard: I've put the stream link, the checkout screens, and the support tickets side by side. The launch is tonight, and the people who buy might come back for more next week.

en/player_f/bfcaf27e.text: Let me try it on my phone. Shipping only shows up after I enter my address, and I have to go back to the product page to check whether my old bottle fits.
en/player_f/bfcaf27e.zh: 我用手機走一次。運費要填完地址才看得到，舊瓶能不能用還得跳回商品頁找。
en/player_f/bfcaf27e.heard: Let me try it on my phone. Shipping only shows up after I enter my address, and I have to go back to the product page to check whether my old bottle fits.

en/player_f/67c46379.text: It says shipping's free. So why did a frozen shipping fee pop up right before payment?
en/player_f/67c46379.zh: 它說免運。我按到付款前，怎麼又多一筆冷凍運費？
en/player_f/67c46379.heard: It says shipping's free, so why did a frozen shipping fee pop up right before payment?

en/data_kai/b73752a9.text: Can you try this? Tap the dumpling promo in LINE and ask support what shipping costs for two bags.
en/data_kai/b73752a9.zh: 妳幫我走一次。從 LINE 的水餃活動點進去，問客服買兩包要不要運費。
en/data_kai/b73752a9.heard: Hey, can you try this? Tap the dumpling promo in Line and ask support what's shipping cost for two bags.

en/ae_mei/79dda298.text: One Less Piece opens its flagship on Linginger Street next week. The client just sent the launch video back.
en/ae_mei/79dda298.zh: 少一件服飾下週在拎薑街開旗艦店。剛剛客戶把開幕片退回來了。
en/ae_mei/79dda298.heard: One, This Piece opens its flagship on Lingelier Street next week. The client just sent the launch video back.

en/client_hsu/c4c2e3c7.text: A customer brought her old bottle in yesterday. She’d bought a refill online, spilled it all over the table, and figured she’d just buy a new bottle this time.
en/client_hsu/c4c2e3c7.zh: 昨天有個客人拿舊瓶來問。她線上買過一包，倒的時候漏了一桌，這次乾脆想買整瓶。
en/client_hsu/c4c2e3c7.heard: A customer brought her old bottle in yesterday. She'd bought a refill online, spilled it all over the table, and figured she'd just buy a new bottle this time.

en/cd_wei/f8346a5b.text: We have to hand the studio back at four. The client will only pay for one plan today. Where do you want to start?
en/cd_wei/f8346a5b.zh: 棚四點要還。客戶今天只肯出一筆預算，你想先動哪一段？
en/cd_wei/f8346a5b.heard: We have to hand the studio back at four. The client will only pay for one plan today. Where do you want to start?

en/client_hsu/08d31d1a.text: Could you take a look at this? The chart shoots up on Saturday, but the counter staff say there’s still a whole case they never opened.
en/client_hsu/08d31d1a.zh: 數據分析師，幫我看一下，這張圖週六還在往上跑，怎麼櫃上說剩一箱沒拆？
en/client_hsu/08d31d1a.heard: Could you take a look at this? The chart shoots up on Saturday, but the counter staff say there's still a whole case they never opened.

en/data_kai/3706bd1d.text: Found it. The bot pulled last year's promo page. Two bags got you free shipping back then.
en/data_kai/3706bd1d.zh: 我找到了。AI 撈到去年的活動頁，那時候兩包就免運。
en/data_kai/3706bd1d.heard: Found it. The bot pulled last year's promo page. Two bags got you free shipping back then.

en/player_f/600908e2.text: This is the kind of report I dread in e-commerce. They've picked a size. Why are we still making them sign up?
en/player_f/600908e2.zh: 我做電商最怕看到這種報表。客人都選好尺寸了，怎麼還要先辦會員？
en/player_f/600908e2.heard: This is the kind of report I dread in e-commerce. They've picked a size. Why are we still making them sign up?

en/player_f/5cfd7a6e.text: I'll write down the item number. Tonight's pitch needs to show how people can find the same jacket again after they buy it.
en/player_f/5cfd7a6e.zh: 我把貨號抄下來。今晚簡報也得寫清楚，客人買完這件，下次怎麼找回來。
en/player_f/5cfd7a6e.heard: I'll write down the item number tonight's pitch needs to show how people can find the same jacket again after they buy it

en/player_f/2b024402.text: Look at this ticket. A regular thought the fee would come off when she signed in. She tried checking out three times, then asked if we'd changed her member perks.
en/player_f/2b024402.zh: 你看這張客服單，熟客以為登入後會扣掉運費。她點了三次結帳，最後問我們是不是改了會員福利。
en/player_f/2b024402.heard: Look at this ticket. A regular thought the fee would come off when she signed in. She tried checking out three times, then asked if we changed her member perks.

en/data_kai/7dcd8870.text: Plenty of people add it to their cart. We lose the most at the address page. As for why buyers never come back, the report can’t tell us that.
en/data_kai/7dcd8870.zh: 購物車加得不少，地址那頁掉最多。至於買過的人為什麼沒回來，報表看不出來。
en/data_kai/7dcd8870.heard: Plenty of people add it to their cart. We lose the most at the address page. As for why buyers never come back, the report can't tell us that.

en/player_f/cb85a17b.text: Okay, I'll bring a test phone. I'll go through the exchange process too, as if the jacket had already arrived.
en/player_f/cb85a17b.zh: 好，我帶測試機去。連收到貨要怎麼換，我也走一遍。
en/player_f/cb85a17b.heard: Okay, I'll bring a test phone. I'll go through the exchange process too, as if the jacket had already arrived.

en/ae_mei/8fb28ef6.text: Follow the old shops to the shrine on Fude Street. The caretaker tried it on last night. Take this tag and ask him what happened.
en/ae_mei/8fb28ef6.zh: 沿著老店走到福德街廟口吧。廟公伯昨晚試穿過，妳拿這張吊牌去問他。
en/ae_mei/8fb28ef6.heard: Follow the old shops to the shrine on Fudo Street. The caretaker tried it on last night. Take this tag and ask him what happened.

en/player_f/4e995f4b.text: Look, I went all the way to the payment screen. I still can't find a number to call if the size is wrong.
en/player_f/4e995f4b.zh: 伯伯你看，我試到付款前，連換尺寸的電話都找不到。
en/player_f/4e995f4b.heard: Look, I went all the way to the payment screen. I still can't find a number to call if the size is wrong.

en/ae_mei/6c68515b.text: The client already made a graphic to celebrate. They need an answer by 5 p.m.. Do we turn the assistant on at every store for the eight o'clock launch tomorrow?
en/ae_mei/6c68515b.zh: 客戶連賀圖都做好了。五點前要我回話，明早八點新品要不要全門市開助理？
en/ae_mei/6c68515b.heard: The client already made a graphic to celebrate. They need an answer by 5:00 p.m. Do we turn the assistant on at every store for the 8:00 launch tomorrow?

en/ae_mei/71ff6ee6.text: One Less Piece opens next week. The client saw the soft-launch report and thinks one more coupon will get those jackets out of people's carts.
en/ae_mei/71ff6ee6.zh: 少一件服飾下週開幕。客戶看試賣報表，說再發一張券，購物車裡的外套就能賣掉。
en/ae_mei/71ff6ee6.heard: One last piece opens next week. The client saw the soft launch report and thinks one more coupon will get those jackets out of people's carts.

en/player_f/1aba1536.text: Manager Hsu, let me match that receipt to the support log. Getting her through checkout and getting her to buy again are two different problems.
en/player_f/1aba1536.zh: 許經理，我把那張發票跟客服紀錄對一下。她第一次下單跟第二次要不要買，卡的是兩件事。
en/player_f/1aba1536.heard: Manager Sue, let me match that receipt to the support log. Getting her through checkout and getting her to buy again are two different problems.

en/tv_su/c7726f47.text: The soy sauce sampler goes live right after tonight’s cooking show. Could you take a look at these comments?
en/tv_su/c7726f47.zh: 今晚料理節目播完，醬油試購組就要上架。妳是顧問，先幫我看這串留言。
en/tv_su/c7726f47.heard: The soy sauce sampler goes live right after tonight's cooking show. Could you take a look at these comments

en/player_f/ca5b8f73.text: If you could check out first, how would you order another bottle when this one runs out?
en/player_f/ca5b8f73.zh: 如果可以先結帳，這瓶用完了，妳想怎麼補？
en/player_f/ca5b8f73.heard: If you could check out first, how would you order another bottle when this one runs out?

en/temple_uncle/1a27a15c.text: Say I want to buy my brother the same jacket later. If I bring in the tag, will the staff know which one it is?
en/temple_uncle/1a27a15c.zh: 我下次想買同一件給我弟，拿吊牌回去，店員會知道是哪件嗎？
en/temple_uncle/1a27a15c.heard: Say I want to buy my brother the same jacket later. If I bring in the tag, will the staff know which one it is?

en/player_f/f0446eff.text: I'll go through them with Ah-Kai. Send me the time on that screenshot too. I want to see if she ever got her refill.
en/player_f/f0446eff.zh: 我請阿凱一起對。截圖的時間也傳我，我想知道她後來有沒有買到。
en/player_f/f0446eff.heard: I'll go through them with Akai. Send me the time on that screenshot too. I want to see if she ever got her refill.

en/ae_mei/dbe2ca60.text: The anniversary sale starts next week. Manager Hsu has room in the budget for one change this week. Which part do you tackle first?
en/ae_mei/dbe2ca60.zh: 週年慶下週就開跑，許經理這週只能先挪一筆預算。你想先救哪一段？
en/ae_mei/dbe2ca60.heard: The anniversary sale starts next week. Manager Shu has room in the budget for one change this week. Which part do you tackle first?

en/player_f/a01c4777.heard: I'll sketch out what you just went through on the back of this order slip. I'm taking it upstairs.

en/temple_uncle/70785b01.text: That's the one! My wife liked it on me. I scanned the tag, then it wanted me to check a text, so I just went home.
en/temple_uncle/70785b01.zh: 昨晚就是這件啦。我試穿給太太看，她說好看。掃了吊牌還要收簡訊，我就先回家了。

en/client_chen/7b505399.text: It’s freezing in this meeting room at Taipei 101. Keep your jacket on and take a look at these two printouts.

en/client_chen/7b505399.heard: It's freezing in this meeting room at Taipei 101. Uh, keep your jacket on and take a look at these two printouts.

en/tv_su/19831363.text: Scanning the code in rehearsal took people straight to sign-up. Someone’s already asked support, “Do I need an account just to buy one bottle?”

en/tv_su/39644bbd.zh: 老闆等著看今晚賣幾組。樓上還有二十分鐘，先去巷口問阿姨，她也掃過。

en/breakfast_auntie/84d713b0.zh: 我就翻訂單找同一瓶啊。上次客服叫我去找商品編號，我哪知道在哪裡。
en/breakfast_auntie/84d713b0.heard: I'd pull up the order and look for the same bottle. Last time, support asked for a product number. How was I supposed to know where to find that?

en/player_f/2f5bf619.zh: 那我把這張單放第九頁。她連要買哪一盒都想好了，差在送單前有沒有看清楚。

ja/ae_mei/d02a3442.text: 今、聞いといたよ。店で割引分の杯数は別に数えられるって。今日の昼までに店長へやり方を伝えてね。
ja/ae_mei/d02a3442.zh: 我剛幫妳問過了。門市願意另記折扣杯數，但今天中午前要給店長做法。

ja/client_wu/221a0e6d.zh: 我昨天才跟老闆說，下週一整面都是我們的。他現在問我，能多賣幾杯？
ja/client_wu/221a0e6d.heard: 昨日、月曜には壁一面うちの広告ですって社長に言ったばかりで、今度は何杯多く売れるのかって

en/boss_lin/456c81bc.heard: It's 9:00. Keep your laptop open, but First Select is pushing skin care reorders this weekend, and their e-commerce lead is waiting for our go-ahead.

ja/clerk_ning/8b914cff.zh: 早班有個送貨的大哥，把上次的空盒放在櫃檯，問我還有沒有。我從收銀台底下拿給他。

ja/boss_lin/5ae6e1f6.heard: 契約に入ってるのは、当初の出稿分だけだ。増額するならサインをもらって。電話で売上まで約束するなよ。

ja/ae_mei/e16b2241.heard: 追加発注書、キーボードの横ね。今夜の広告枠は11時半まで仮押さえ。取るならそれまでにサインがいるよ。
